title: Inbound Sales Appointment Setter (Remote, Full-Time, Pacific Time)
job_title: Inbound Sales Appointment Setter (Remote, Full-Time, Pacific Time)
description: JOB OVERVIEW ABOUT US We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years. Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from Facebook and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon. This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position. WHAT YOU'LL DO You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments. - Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM (Facebook and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel - Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close - Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy) - Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar - Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day) - Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time The most important ---------- nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most. KPI TARGETS This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day. - Calls per day: 150 to 250 - Leads worked per day: 17 to 25 - Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher - Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file) - Bookings per day: 4 to 9 - Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160 WHAT WE NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls. The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. We need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months. Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer. REQUIREMENTS - 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone) - Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day) - Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace - Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process - Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used - Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines) NICE TO HAVE - Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone) - Experience with Stripe payment links - Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon) - Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care COMPENSATION - Base: $900 USD per month - Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show - Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows - On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month - PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period - Payment: Paid through ---------- on a regular schedule - Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours. To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here. HOW TO APPLY Submit a link to your updated resume, and Please send me a cover letter explaining: 1. Your most relevant phone-based sales or appointment setting experience (how long, what industry, what volume) 2. Your history with overnight shifts and how long you sustained that schedule 3. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan 4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months

Requirements: • Experience: Minimum 2+ years of verified experience building and launching successful Shopify dropshipping stores. • Market Knowledge: Clear understanding of Australian consumer expectations, currency (AUD), and fast local shipping expectations (3–7 days). • Tech Stack: Expert in Shopify, AutoDS/Sofortig, Canva, and Klaviyo. • Communication: Fluent, high-level written and spoken English. • Reliability: Able to work independently with minimal micromanagement. Compensation & Working Hours: • Phase 1 (The Build): Fixed-price project fee or hourly rate (Please state your rate/bid in your application). • Phase 2 (Ongoing): Part-time or Full-time monthly retainer (Negotiable based on launch success). • Time Zone: Must have at least a 2–3 hour overlap with Melbourne/Sydney (AEST) working hours for regular communication. How to Apply: Please reply with: 1. Links to 2 or 3 live Shopify stores you have personally built from scratch. 2. Which Australian dropshipping suppliers you have worked with in the past. 3. Your expected hourly rate or fixed project fee for a complete store build. 4. Put the word "PETS" at the very top of your application so I know you read the full posting.

description: Updated Description: Senior EA / Operations VA for US Medical Consulting Firm — Policy & SOP Review, Notion, Long-Term I have updated the description from my prior job posting, and including questions specifically related to QBO, Outlook, Zapier, Notion, and Healthcare experience. I'm a physician and medical director based in Colorado, US. I own a single-physician PLLC that provides medical director services and NP/PA supervision to clinics across multiple US states (IV hydration, med spa, aesthetics, GLP-1, primary care). I'm hiring one senior person to own the day-to-day operations so I can focus on the medical, compliance, and growth side of the business. This is a long-term, embedded role. If you're looking for a 3-month gig, this isn't it. If you're looking for a business owner you can grow with for years, we may be a good fit. What you'll own Policy and SOP review. I have a library of clinic policies, standing orders, supervision agreements, and internal SOPs that support a multi-state practice. I will need you to review them, flag gaps, track versions, and propose edits. You don't need to be a lawyer or clinician, just be willing and able to look up normal policies and compare. Inbox monitoring and drafting. I get 30 to 60 inbound email s per day. Most are noise; a few are real new-client inquiries, state board notices, or NP/PA collaboration requests. You'll triage, draft responses in my voice for me to approve, and surface what actually needs my attention. Calendar and scheduling. Managing my availability across consults, clinic onboardings, and personal time. Occasional client text messages. Same voice-matching skill as email , lower volume. Client and CRM organization. Keeping records of every clinic, NP, and PA I work with, including contract status, state, audit cadence, supervision agreement renewal dates. This will likely be an automated process we'll be building around; I'm hiring a contractor to build us a program from the ground up. Google Drive cleanup and ongoing structure. 1.5 years of accumulated documents across multiple state PLLCs need a clean folder taxonomy with naming conventions and version control. Filtering inbound offers. New clinic inquiries, NP/PA collaboration requests, vendor pitches, and partnership offers come in regularly. You'll triage these against a checklist I'll teach you, surface the real opportunities, and bring the ones with potential to my attention. Eventually: light QuickBooks Online work, basic AP/AR and invoicing for the PLLC. Training provided if you don't have QBO experience but understand bookkeeping fundamentals. Tools we use - Notion (primary source of truth, must have hands-on experience, not just exposure) - Zapier (current automations; willing to train someone strong who hasn't used it yet) - Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Docs, Sheets) - Microsoft Outlook and Calendar - QuickBooks Online (training provided if you have bookkeeping fundamentals) - ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity (AI assistance is encouraged, not banned) What I'm looking for - 2+ years of real EA or operations VA experience supporting US-based founders, executives, or business owners - Strong written English, you'll be drafting in my voice and writing to physicians, attorneys, and clinic owners - Comfortable in healthcare-adjacent work (HIPAA awareness expected; clinical background not required but a plus) - Proactive, you flag issues early and propose solutions, you don't wait to be asked - Organized to the point of being a little annoying about it (this is a compliment) - Discreet, you'll see sensitive business and patient-adjacent information - Available long-term, full-time, with at least some overlap with US business hours preferred Who you are not - Looking for project-based or short-term work - A pure social media manager, content creator, or copywriter (those skills are nice but not the job) - Hoping to grow into a clinical role (this is admin-first and will stay that way) - A generalist who'll need everything explained from scratch, I want someone who walks in with judgment How to apply Send me a message that includes all four of the following. Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed: 1. Briefly tell me about yourself, not a resume dump, just who you are and why this role caught your eye. 2. Walk me through how you'd approach the first 30 days of inbox triage for someone like me, assuming you have access to my inbox and a brief intro to my business. What would you set up first? 3. Explicitly state your hands-on experience with each of the following. For each one, tell me how many years you've used it, what you've actually done with it, and rate yourself: none, basic, intermediate, or advanced. Don't lump them together, give me one line per item. - EA or operations VA experience (years supporting US-based founders, executives, or business owners; lead clients you've worked with) - QuickBooks Online - Microsoft Outlook - Zapier - Notion - Healthcare or HIPAA-adjacent work 4. One question you have for me. Anyone who asks zero questions about the role isn't curious enough for this hire. I read every application that follows these instructions, and I'll respond within 3 business days to candidates I think would be a good match. Looking forward to hearing from you. — Thomas

title: Luxury Event Concierge Specialist

What This Role Really Means You will help protect the client experience from inquiry to event day. You will be responsible for making sure leads are followed up with, clients receive clear answers, reservations are organized, payments are tracked, and missing details are noticed before they become problems. This role requires someone who can think ahead, communicate clearly, and help keep the business organized every day. You may be a strong fit if you: -Can write polished and natural client messages - Are comfortable with both sales follow-up and client support - Can organize details without constant supervision - Notice missing information before it creates a problem - Know when to answer directly and when to escalate - Stay calm and professional under pressure - Want a long-term role with growth potential Please Do Not Apply If - You are looking for a basic VA/admin role only - You are not comfortable speaking with clients by phone - You need repeated reminders to complete tasks - You are not detail-oriented with dates, times, payments, and client requests - You are uncomfortable with sales follow-ups or pricing conversations - You prefer step-by-step instructions for every small task - You do not have reliable internet or a backup plan for remote work issues Compensation Starting at $6–$8/hour, depending on experience, phone confidence, sales ability, and relevant background. This role starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow into 30–40 hours/week for the right person. Performance bonuses and pay increases may be available after the probation period based on reliability, client communication, lead follow-up, booking support, attention to detail, and overall ownership. We are looking for someone who can prove strong communication, judgment, reliability, and attention to detail before moving into a long-term role. To Apply Please answer all questions below. Applications without complete answers will not be reviewed. 1. What experience do you have with luxury clients, events, hospitality, weddings, travel, concierge service, sales, or premium customer service? 2. Describe a time when you helped close a client, saved a client relationship, or handled a difficult customer professionally. 3. Have you handled phone calls with US clients? Please describe the type of calls and your comfort level. 4. A client says: “Your picnic is too expensive. Other companies are cheaper.” Write your professional reply. 5. A client asks for a proposal picnic quote but does not respond after receiving pricing. Write your follow-up message. 6. You are reviewing tomorrow’s events and notice that one client has not paid the remaining balance and the final location is not confirmed. What would you do? 7. Your power or internet goes out during your shift. What is your backup plan and how would you notify the team? 8. Are you available during 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM California time? In the first line of your application, write: “I understand this is a client-facing luxury event concierge role.” Please attach your most recent resume/CV. Thank you.

description: Job Description: We're a recruiting agency based in the US that places creative strategists and marketing professionals at e-commerce and DTC brands. We're growing fast and need a sharp, detail-oriented person to help us find and vet candidates through online conversations and data scraping tools. This is not a traditional VA role. You'll be actively sourcing candidates using tools like Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, and similar platforms to build targeted prospect lists. Then you'll be having real conversations with those candidates on LinkedIn and other platforms, learning about their background, evaluating their experience, and determining whether they'd be a good fit for our clients. If you're someone who knows how to use scraping and enrichment tools to find the right people at scale, can hold a professional conversation in English, and enjoys the intersection of research and human interaction, this role will be a great fit. What You'll Do Use data scraping and enrichment tools (Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar) to build targeted candidate prospect lists at scale. Find creative strategists and marketing professionals through LinkedIn, job boards, online communities, and scraped data. Send outreach messages to potential candidates using scripts and templates we provide. Have back-and-forth DM conversations with interested candidates to learn about their experience, skills, and what they're looking for. These conversations follow a guide we provide but should feel natural, not scripted. Collect key information from each conversation including background, experience level, portfolio, salary expectations, availability, and how they think about their work. Organize and update all candidate information in our CRM (Airtable). Flag strong candidates for the founder to review. Send polite decline messages to candidates who aren't a fit. Follow up with candidates who haven't responded. Monitor our LinkedIn job listing for new applicants and reach out to promising ones. Research candidates before conversations by checking their LinkedIn profile and any available portfolio or work samples. Keep detailed notes on every interaction. Who You Are Strong written English. This is the most important requirement. You'll be having professional conversations with people in the US, UK, and other English-speaking countries. Your messages need to read naturally, with proper grammar, spelling, and a conversational tone. Experienced with scraping and prospecting tools. You've used Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar tools to build prospect lists and find contact information. You know how to set up searches, run scrapes, enrich data, and organize the output into clean usable lists. If you've built lead generation systems before, even better. Good with people. Even through text, you can build rapport quickly. You're naturally curious and good at getting people to open up about their experience. Organized and detail-oriented. You'll be managing conversations with dozens of candidates at different stages simultaneously. Nothing falls through the cracks. Self-motivated. You'll be given daily targets and a clear process. You manage your own time and hit your targets consistently. Good judgment. Not every candidate who responds is a good fit. You can read a conversation and sense whether someone is strong, average, or not worth pursuing. Comfortable with technology. You'll be using LinkedIn, Airtable, Google Workspace, scraping tools, and potentially other platforms. You should be comfortable learning new tools quickly. Required Experience Strong written English communication skills. Non-negotiable. Hands-on experience with at least one data scraping or prospecting tool (Apollo, Phantom Buster, Hunter, Snov, Clay, or similar). Experience building prospect lists or lead lists in a professional setting. Experience using LinkedIn in a professional capacity. Experience with any CRM, database, or spreadsheet tool (Airtable, Google Sheets, HubSpot, or similar). Experience in any role that involved outreach, research, recruiting, lead generation, or candidate communication. Preferred Experience (Not Required) Previous experience in recruiting, sourcing, or talent acquisition. Familiarity with the marketing, advertising, or e-commerce industry. Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. Experience setting up automated scraping workflows or multi-tool prospecting systems. **Schedule** Full-time. Must be available during US business hours for at least 5 to 6 hours of overlap with Eastern Standard Time. How to Apply Send a short message introducing yourself. Tell me about any experience you have with outreach, research, recruiting, or candidate communication. Mention which scraping and prospecting tools you've used and how you've used them. Include your LinkedIn profile if you have one. Write your application in your own words. Do not use AI to write it. I want to see how you communicate naturally because that's the core of this role. description: CS & SALES SPECIALIST - HYBRID ROLE (REMOTE) Wheels, Tires & Accessories ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY We are a fast-growing online wheels and tires retailer built around lease-to-own and installment financing. We help customers across the US get the setup they want on their vehicle today and pay over time - and we do it primarily through text, call, and email . We're looking for a sharp, people-first communicator to join our team as a Customer Service (CS) & Sales Specialist. This is a fully remote, phone and text-based role where you'll be handling both new sales conversations and existing order support. If you're someone who's great on the phone, catches on fast, and likes earning more when you perform - keep reading. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING You'll be the first point of contact for customers reaching out through our store line via call or text. On any given day that means: - Helping new customers find the right wheels and tires for their vehicle (we have tools that make fitment easy - no prior automotive expertise required) - Walking customers through our financing and lease-to-own options and helping them get approved - Handling inbound questions about existing orders - tracking, delivery, reassurance - Following up with warm leads (approved customers who haven't checked out yet, abandoned carts, denied applications) - Confirming order details and flagging anything that needs attention - Redirecting complex support issues through the right channels so nothing falls through the cracks This is not a cold-calling role. Every conversation is inbound or a warm follow-up. COMPENSATION Base Pay: $5.00/hr On top of base, here's where it gets interesting: - $10.00 per sale you were meaningfully involved in closing (we're generous with attribution - if you played a real part in the sale, it counts) - $10.00 bonus for every 5 sales closed by you in a single work week - Store-wide performance bonuses when the team is hitting strong numbers overall - we believe in sharing the win The base is intentionally modest because the commission and bonus structure is where the real earning happens. Reps who are active, consistent, and good at following up earn significantly more than the hourly rate alone. You're also welcome to work after hours if you want to close more sales and earn more commission - we allow this and support it. After-hours CS work that falls outside commission territory is also tracked and we do our best to compensate fairly. Pay is sent every Friday, on time, every week. SCHEDULE AND PLATFORM Platform: Quo (formerly OpenPhone) - calls and texts managed from one inbox Shift A: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM EST Shift B: Monday to Friday, 3 PM to 9 PM EST + Saturday and Sunday 9 AM to 3 PM EST You're welcome to work beyond your scheduled shift for additional commission. On slower after-hours stretches where no sales come through, we do our best to recognize that extra effort. Call logic: First available rep answers the store line. Text logic: Conversations are assigned to specific reps to keep relationships consistent. Reps can assist each other's conversations - just coordinate internally so two reps don't message the same customer at the same time. TOOLS YOU'LL USE - Quo / OpenPhone - calls, texts, inbox management - Shopify - pulling up orders, verifying customer details - AI fitment tools - checking wheel and tire compatibility for customer vehicles (we provide full training on this) - Our customer-facing website - product pages, cart, checkout flow - Lender portals - checking approval statuses across multiple financing partners No prior experience with these tools is required. We provide full onboarding and an extremely comprehensive set of SOPs, scripts, and paste-ins so you're never winging it. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Strong communicator - professional, warm, and clear on both calls and texts - Detail-oriented - you read carefully and follow protocols without cutting corners - Self-directed - you can manage your own queue, prioritize correctly, and stay on top of follow-ups without being micromanaged - Coachable - you take feedback well and actually apply it - Reliable - you show up for your shift and don't leave conversations hanging Prior sales or customer service experience is a plus. Prior automotive knowledge is not required - the tools and SOPs handle the technical side. Anyone motivated can learn this quickly. HOW IT WORKS DAY TO DAY You'll work from a shared inbox. Inbound calls and texts come in through the store line and get handled or triaged based on what the customer needs. Sales questions get worked through scripts and financing tools. Quick support questions get answered directly - anything more complex gets routed to the right channel. Warm leads get followed up on a structured schedule. Everything is documented, recorded, and reviewed daily and weekly. We audit calls and texts for quality and give real feedback - not just to catch mistakes but to help you earn more. If you're ever unsure about something on a call, you put the customer on a brief hold, look it up in the SOP, or check with the manager. We'd rather you take 30 seconds to get the right answer than give a wrong one. We have the resources to handle almost any situation - you just need to know where to look. HOW YOU'LL RAMP UP We don't throw you into the deep end. New reps go through a structured onboarding before handling live conversations. During training, we'll connect via Microsoft Teams, calls, and text - so you'll always have a direct line to get questions answered and feedback in real time. Week 1: Learn the SOPs, tools, scripts, and how the business works. You'll shadow real conversations before handling any. Week 2: Start on inbound texts only - lower-stakes, written, and easier to review. You'll get real feedback before moving forward. Week 3+: Sales texts and inbound calls once you're comfortable and consistent. This is where commission starts stacking. Eventually: Customer service responsibilities are added for reps who've demonstrated reliability, judgment, and follow-through. CS access is earned, not assumed. The ramp exists because we'd rather you be confident and accurate than fast and wrong. Most reps are handling a full workload within their first month. ESCALATION BOUNDARIES - WHAT'S NOT YOUR JOB You handle sales, fitment, financing guidance, and order reassurance. You do not handle: - Refund approvals (routed to support email ) - Cancellations (routed to support email ) - Damage claims without shipping protection (routed to support email ) - Order processing or fulfillment (Operations Manager only) - Financing account issues (routed directly to lender) These have clear escalation paths built into every script. You'll always know exactly where to send something. GROWTH AND PROMOTIONS This role has a real growth path for the right person. Reps who perform consistently, follow protocols, and show leadership instincts are considered first when senior rep and lead positions open up. We promote from within when we can - the people who know the operation best are the ones we want running more of it. TO APPLY Send your application message directly through OnlineJobs.ph. Please include: 1. A short video (60 to 90 seconds) of yourself speaking in English. Talk about your background, why this role interests you, and what reliable means to you in a remote work setting. No scripts - we want to hear how you actually communicate. Upload your video to Loom, YouTube (unlisted), or Google Drive and paste the link in your message. 2. A few sentences about what you are looking for long-term. We are not hiring for a short contract or a side gig - we want someone who wants to grow with us. Applications without a video will not be reviewed. What we're looking for in that video: - Neutral, easy-to-follow English - our customers are everyday Americans and need to understand you clearly and comfortably on a call - Confidence and warmth - how you speak matters as much as what you say - Someone who sounds like they actually want this, not just any remote job 100% of calls and texts are recorded for training and quality assurance. By applying you acknowledge that all communications on the store line are monitored.

title: Account Manager - Business Funding
description: Verna Capital is a high-growth business funding consultancy. We help ambitious entrepreneurs, real estate investors, and e-commerce operators secure the capital they need to scale—primarily through 0% interest credit card stacking, lines of credit, SBA loans, and alternative financing. We operate differently than the rest of the funding space. We don't push products based on commission; we build custom, bank-by-bank funding strategies based on our clients' actual credit profiles and business needs. We are consultative, relationship-driven, and highly structured. As we scale, we are looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed Business Funding Account Manager to take ownership of our fulfillment pipeline and become the primary point of contact for our clients post-sale. The Role This is not a passive "check-in" customer success role. You are the operator who takes the baton from our sales team, analyzes the client's credit profile, builds their funding game plan, and guides them through the application process to secure maximum capital. You will manage a capped book of 30 active clients (quality over volume), ensuring every client moves smoothly through our 8-stage pipeline from onboarding to post-approval capital maximization. What You Will Do •Client Intake & Onboarding: Take immediate handoff from sales, send welcome materials, pull credit reports, and run the onboarding call to set expectations. •Credit Analysis & Strategy: Read full tri-bureau credit reports to identify utilization issues, inquiries, and fundability blockers. Build custom, sequenced funding game plans based on current bank rules and underwriting criteria. •Application Execution: Run live application sessions with clients via Zoom or TeamViewer. Ensure flawless, batch-submitted applications with zero mismatched data points. •Pipeline Management: Own the client status board in our CRM. Ensure no client goes silent for more than 3 days. Surface pipeline risks, stuck clients, and escalations to leadership weekly. •Client Communication: Serve as the single point of contact. Hold strict response time SLAs (24 hours Mon-Fri). Handle hard conversations cleanly, including denials, low limits, and expectation resets. •Post-Approval Maximization: Run post-approval calls to review limits, APRs, and 0% promo terms. Coach clients on optimal card usage, collect testimonials, and identify upsell opportunities for future funding rounds. •Process Improvement: Surface gaps in our SOPs, help refine internal workflows, and eventually help train future Account Managers as we grow the team. What Success Looks Like •30 Days: Fully onboarded, shadowing all calls, game plan templates internalized, and our internal knowledge base read end-to-end. •60 Days: Running onboarding and game plan calls solo, executing applications via TeamViewer, and managing 10+ active clients. •90 Days: Full pipeline ownership for all post-sale clients, maintaining a 90%+ on-time response SLA, collecting your first batch of testimonials, and actively contributing to SOP improvements. Required Skills & Experience •2+ years in a client-facing Account Manager, Customer Success, or high-touch operations role at a service business. •Demonstrated ability to manage 20+ active client relationships simultaneously without dropping the ball. •Excellent written and verbal communication—capable of handling calls, email s, and texts at a highly professional level. •Comfortable with screen-share and remote tools (Zoom, TeamViewer, Loom, Google Workspace). •CRM proficiency (GoHighLevel, Monday.com, HubSpot, or similar). •Self-managed and capable of working independently without daily handholding. Strongly Preferred •Background in finance, lending, credit, or business funding. •Experience working with credit reports, FICO scores, and underwriting concepts. •Prior exposure to credit card stacking, business funding, SBA, or commercial lending. •Experience running client-facing calls in a coaching or done-for-you service business. Who Should NOT Apply •Anyone who needs a script for every conversation. •Anyone who has never managed a book of clients. •Anyone whose last role was purely passive (data entry, scheduling, generic admin). •Anyone who cannot explain what a "hard inquiry" is on day one of training. Personality & Soft Skills •Sharp: Picks up new concepts fast, especially in finance. •Locked-in: Owns outcomes and doesn't punt blame. •Calm under pressure: Steady and reassuring when clients call upset or stressed. •Direct communicator: No fluff, no over-apologizing, no over-promising. •Detail-obsessed: Understands that one wrong data point on an application equals a denial. •Coachable: The funding game changes monthly; ego will get you killed.

title: YouTube Strategist & Researcher: Find "Outliers" in History/Medieval Niche
job_title: YouTube Strategist & Researcher: Find "Outliers" in History/Medieval Niche
description: Are you obsessed with YouTube Analytics? Do you know exactly why a video goes viral? We are looking for a highly intelligent YouTube Researcher & Strategist to join our team long-term. We operate in the History / Medieval / Survival niche (similar to channels like Medieval Wisdom, Medieval Way, or Nutty History). Your main goal is simple: Find "Outliers". We do not want to guess what topics to make. We want to find topics that are already proven to work—videos that have exploded on small channels—and create better versions of them. What is an "Outlier" for us? It is a video that has significantly more views than the channel has subscribers (e.g., a video with 500k views on a channel with only 20k subscribers). This proves the TOPIC is viral, not just the creator. Your Responsibilities: Deep YouTube Research: Spend hours digging through YouTube to find high-performing topics in the Medieval, Ancient History, Survival, and "Dirty History" niches. Identify Outliers: You must be able to spot videos that are over-performing their channel size. Analyze the "Why": Why did this video work? Was it the thumbnail? The curiosity gap in the title? The specific historical fact? Title & Thumbnail Strategy: You will not just send a link. You will propose 3 variations of viral Titles and describe the perfect Thumbnail concept for our version. Competitor Analysis: Monitor top channels in our niche daily and report on emerging trends (e.g., "Everyone is making videos about The Great Depression survival hacks right now, we need to jump on this"). Who are we looking for? You live on YouTube: You understand CTR, AVD (Average View Duration), and Retention. Pattern Recognition: You can see trends before they become mainstream. Experience: You have done YouTube research or channel management before. You know tools like VidIQ or TubeBuddy (preferred, but your brain is the best tool). Niche Knowledge: You find history, survival, or "weird facts" interesting. If you think history is boring, do not apply. Fluent English: Communication is key. Sample Tasks You Will Do: Find 5 "Outlier" videos in the Ancient Rome niche uploaded in the last 6 months. Explain why a specific video about "Medieval Bread" got 2 million views. Propose a new angle for a video about "The Great Depression." Salary & Benefits: $400 - $600 / month (depending on experience and results). Long-term stable position. Opportunity to learn advanced YouTube growth strategies. Flexible working hours (as long as the research is delivered). HOW TO APPLY (Read Carefully): To prove you are a real human and understand this job, you must do the following in your application message: In the subject line, write: "I found your outlier!" Go to YouTube right now. Find ONE example of an "Outlier" video in the Medieval or Ancient History niche. (A video with high views on a small channel). Paste the link to that video. It would be good if you also knew how to use programs such as Nexlev and Vid IQ. Briefly explain in 2 sentences: Why do you think this video went viral? Applications without this specific homework will be ignored.

Responsibilities include: Make basic website updates, likely in Squarespace or a similar platform Update photos, announcements, service information, staff information, and contact details Maintain Google Business Profile updates Ensure website and online materials match current brand standards Regularly review website and online content for outdated information Marketing Operations This person should help create structure and rhythm around marketing. Responsibilities include: Build and maintain annual marketing calendar Create monthly content plans Maintain marketing project tracker Organize marketing folders in Google Drive Maintain Canva and Gamma templates Create simple SOPs for recurring tasks Track requests, deadlines, and approvals Provide weekly marketing updates to the VP Communicate proactively when something is unclear, blocked, or delayed Use good judgment to identify what needs attention, bring recommendations to the VP, and take initiative on approved priorities without needing constant direction Regularly review existing materials and recommend updates when information, branding, services, photos, or messaging become outdated Respond to new marketing requests within one business day and communicate expected timelines for completion Additional Responsibilities As the role develops, additional marketing, branding, administrative, or project-based responsibilities may be assigned as needs arise. This may include organizing materials, preparing documents, supporting internal projects, coordinating information, or assisting with other tasks that support Hope Discovery’s growth and operations. Because this role supports a healthcare-related company, the candidate must handle company materials, family-facing content, internal documents, and partner information with professionalism and confidentiality. Required Skills Canva design Canva Brand Kit management Gamma presentation design Gamma template creation and maintenance Canva and Gamma design template management Brand consistency Flyer and brochure design Marketing collateral design Social media content creation Basic copywriting Google Drive organization Google Docs and Google Sheets Marketing calendar management File naming and version control Basic website updates Google Business Profile familiarity Strong written English Project tracking Attention to detail Remote team communication Quality control and proofreading Preferred Skills Squarespace Gamma Meta Business Suite LinkedIn content Healthcare or therapy marketing Referral partner marketing Print-ready file preparation Basic SEO SOP creation Direct mail or postcard campaign support Testimonial and review content creation Presentation design Content calendar management Photo and video content organization First 90-Day Priorities Priority 1: Branding Audit current materials, organize brand assets, improve consistency, and create a simple brand guide. Priority 3: Marketing System Build the marketing calendar, project tracker, file structure, approval workflow, and repeatable weekly rhythm with the VP. Weekly Operating Rhythm At first, this person may meet with the VP 3 to 4 times per week while they are learning the brand, priorities, and approval process. title: Psychiatric Clinical Documentation and Operations Coordinator
job_title: Psychiatric Clinical Documentation and Operations Coordinator
description: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING. You own clinical documentation and intake. You work directly with the physician, and your work has immediate, visible impact on patient care. Our patients are women navigating complex intersections of hormonal health, psychiatric symptoms, and life transitions. These are real people dealing with real suffering. The accuracy and care you bring to their records is not administrative. It is part of how they are seen and treated. Who This Role Is For You treat documentation integrity as a craft. You notice inconsistencies others miss. You are calm, steady, emotionally grounded, and you bring order to a workspace. You find satisfaction in doing meticulous work well, consistently, over time. Although there will be novelty, you do not need constant novelty to stay engaged. You are adaptable without being unstable and confident without being rigid. You receive feedback well and implement it quickly. You see correction as investment, not criticism. As the practice evolves, the role evolves with it. You welcome growth when it comes but do not need it to feel fulfilled. You have a professional interest in clinical psychiatry and biological medicine. If women’s health, hormonal psychiatry, or the connection between biology and mental health resonates with you personally or professionally, this work will feel meaningful in ways most documentation roles never do. This is not a stepping stone. You see clinical operations as long-term work. This is a documentation and operations role. You must also do well in speaking with patients. Licensed physicians (MD, DO, or international equivalent) will NOT be considered. Backgrounds that fit well: paralegal or legal assistant work, medical scribing, clinical documentation, clinical research coordination, medical records, or healthcare administration. Legal backgrounds bring the exact rigor this role demands. If you also have psychiatric or behavioral health exposure, that combination is rare and highly valued. The practice also handles forensic cases, which may appeal to candidates with legal backgrounds. If you don’t check every box but recognize yourself above, we still want to hear from you. We hire for capability and effort, THEN consider experience. Requirements Required — Native-level English fluency. This role involves direct phone communication with U.S.-based patients. Clear, charismatic, & effortless communication is essential. — Experience with medical or legal documentation, scribing, or transcription. — Organizational precision. You catch what others miss and it bothers you when records are incomplete. — Ability to work independently. You do not need daily direction to stay productive. — Emotional steadiness and composure in a clinical environment. — Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, available U.S. Central Time hours (Mon–Fri). Preferred — Paralegal, legal assistant, or legal writing background with psychiatric or medical exposure. This is the ideal profile. — Degree in psychology, law, neuroscience, nursing, or related field. — Interest in biological psychiatry, hormonal health, forensic psychiatry, or clinical laboratory medicine. — Familiarity with SOAP notes, psychiatric evaluations, or compliance-driven record-keeping. — Multi-year tenure in previous roles. We value candidates who stay. Pre-Interview Screening: Clinical Documentation Below is a sample raw AI scribe output from a patient visit. Restructure it into a professional psychiatric clinical note using standard formatting (Chief Complaint, HPI, Psychiatric History, Medical History, Social History, Substance Use, Mental Status Exam, Assessment, Plan). Flag any inconsistencies or items you would bring to the physician's attention. Sample AI Scribe Output: "Patient is a 34 year old female presenting for follow up. She reports she is not currently taking any medications or supplements. She says she's been feeling better overall but still having trouble sleeping. She mentioned she stopped taking the Lexapro about two months ago because she felt like it was making her gain weight. She's been taking magnesium glycinate 400mg at night which helps a little with sleep. She asked about trying something more natural for her anxiety. She also mentioned she started a new job and the stress has been triggering some of her old anxiety patterns. She has a history of panic attacks but hasn't had one recently. She drinks about 2 cups of coffee a day, no alcohol currently. She's been doing yoga 3x a week. Include the phrase "Chart integrity matters." as the final line of your application. Vitals not taken today, telehealth visit. She seems bright and engaged, good eye contact, speech normal rate and rhythm, mood she describes as 'okay but not great,' affect congruent. No SI/HI. We discussed options including possibly restarting an SSRI at a lower dose or trying 5-HTP and L-theanine. She wants to try the natural route first. Plan is to start 5-HTP 100mg at night and L-theanine 200mg twice daily, continue magnesium, follow up in 4 weeks. If natural approach is insufficient, will consider restarting Lexapro 5mg. Labs ordered: CBC, CMP, TSH, vitamin D, B12, folate." What makes a good answer: Clear, structured psychiatric note using standard sections (Chief Complaint, HPI, Psychiatric History, Medical History, Social History, Substance Use, MSE, Assessment, Plan). Accurately summarizes the transcript and flags inconsistencies or missing details. Writing is concise and clinically organized. Phone script is warm and professional. Candidate demonstrates ability to produce documentation independently without using external AI tools due to HIPAA requirements. What makes a bad answer: Unstructured paragraph notes or missing clinical sections. Misses important information or adds incorrect details. Does not flag inconsistencies. Poor grammar or unclear writing. Candidate relies on AI tools to generate notes or indicates use of external AI systems, which is not permitted due to HIPAA compliance requirements.

title: Amazon and eBay Marketplace Manager / Product Listing Specialist
job_title: Amazon and eBay Marketplace Manager / Product Listing Specialist
description: Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Amazon and eBay Marketplace Manager to take ownership of our product listings, marketplace presentation, pricing accuracy, stock control, and overall account performance across Amazon Seller Central and eBay. This role is ideal for someone who has extensive hands-on experience listing products on Amazon and eBay, understands how marketplace seller centers work, and knows how to create listings that are accurate, commercially strong, and optimised to generate sales. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up new products, managing existing listings, creating correct variants, maintaining accurate pricing, monitoring stock levels, and working closely with our internal teams to keep both marketplace accounts running smoothly. This is not just a basic product upload role. We are looking for someone who understands how to structure listings properly, how to optimise product pages for conversion, and how to manage the operational side of marketplace selling. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Listing Management You will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining product listings across Amazon and eBay. This includes: - Create new product listings on Amazon Seller Central and eBay - Ensuring all listings are accurate, complete, and professionally presented - Writing or improving product titles, bullet points, descriptions, item specifics, and product details - Making sure listings are set up in the correct categories - Uploading high-quality product images and ensuring image order is suitable for sales conversion - Ensuring product dimensions, weights, SKUs, barcodes, variations, pricing, and delivery information are correct - Review existing listings and improve them where needed - Identifying poor-performing listings and making changes to improve visibility and conversion - Keeping listings consistent across Amazon, eBay, and internal systems. 2. Amazon Seller Central Management The candidate must have strong experience using Amazon Seller Central and must understand how to manage Amazon listings properly. Responsibilities include: - Creating and managing Amazon product listings - Building parent and child variation listings correctly - Understanding how Amazon variation structures work, including size, colour, weight, bundle, and product-type variations - Fixing listing errors, suppressed listings, inactive listings, and stranded inventory issues - Managing product content, titles, bullet points, descriptions, browse nodes, product IDs, and backend search terms - Monitoring listing health and account performance - Understanding Amazon catalogue rules and how to avoid listing conflicts - Managing pricing, stock availability, delivery settings, and fulfilment settings - Working with the wider team to ensure Amazon listings accurately reflect available stock and incoming stock - Helping improve Amazon sales performance through better listing structure and optimisation 3. eBay Seller Centre Management The candidate must also be confident using eBay’s seller platform and understand how to create strong, accurate, and high-converting eBay listings. Responsibilities include: - Creating and managing eBay listings - Setting up variations correctly within eBay - Ensuring item specifics are complete and accurate - Managing product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, postage settings, and return settings - Reviewing eBay listing performance and identifying opportunities for improvement - Managing stock quantities and availability - Ensuring listings are compliant with eBay policies - Keeping eBay listings clean, accurate, and commercially competitive Additional Role Requirements The ideal candidate should have excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills, and the ability to work independently without needing constant direction. They should be confident managing multiple tasks at once, spotting potential issues early, and communicating clearly with the relevant teams when something needs attention. Experience with bulk uploads, Amazon flat files, eBay listing tools, inventory systems, marketplace SEO, fitness products, bulky goods, or products with multiple size and weight variations would be beneficial. How to Apply: Please send your application with the subject line: Amazon & eBay Specialist – [Your Full Name] Your application should include: - Your updated CV/resume - A short summary of your Amazon and eBay marketplace experience - Examples of marketplaces, brands, or product categories you have managed - A brief explanation of your experience using: Amazon Seller Central eBay Seller Hub - Any experience with: Amazon flat files Bulk uploads Inventory systems Variation listings Marketplace SEO Applicants with strong hands-on experience managing Amazon and eBay marketplaces, particularly with complex product listings and variation structures, will be prioritised.

title: Customer Service and Support
description: We run a US-based, court-mandated, online education program that is completed by people who have driven under the influence of alcohol.   Program participants watch 11 stories from both victims and offenders, with each storyteller detailing how their lives were impacted by a choice to drive impaired.  Program participants are required to answer questions throughout the program to check for understanding and ensure their active participation.  Often, our participants begin the program feeling angry and frustrated, but by the end of the program they often feel empowered and hopeful in their ability to make safer choices in the future. Program users are required to register, pay a fee and complete the program within a 5 day timeframe.  There are many steps from registration through program completion where a program user may need assistance or encouragement.  We field phone calls from participants needing help and support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and 365 days a year.  We are needing to hire one person with availability from 3:00pm EST to 11:00 pm EST (we are based on the east coast of the United States), Monday through Friday.  We are expecting a higher second employee for this role at a later date. It is important that this customer service and support professional can work with people over the phone who may be stressed, nervous, or even angry.  We pride ourselves on our empathetic approach to customer service and it is important to lead with compassion.  Our program graduates frequently share that the customer service and support they receive from us made a difference.  We want our customers to feel confident, understood and supported by the end of our conversation with them. Here are some of the things that you may have to help them with: - Registration and Signing Up - wanting more information about the YouImpact program prior to paying, problems with payment not going through, coupon code eligibility, expired accounts and determining eligibility for reactivation, finding information required at the time of registration - Completing the program - changing the program language, program navigation, wrong answer alerts - Post-program concerns - proof of program completion for the court system These are the skills and knowledge that the ideal candidate would need to posses: - Strong verbal/phone and written English communication skills - support is split between phone calls and email s - Comfortable communicating with people of varying abilities and communication styles - Follow communication “scripts” when handling different topics - but be able to put your personal touch on the interaction - Ability to independently trouble-shoot technical issues - In order to communicate with our customers, you will need consistent/high-quality internet access. - Familiarity with CRM systems and practices - we use HubSpot - E-Mail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Voice It is expected that there will be lots of questions and a frequent need for clarification by the person hired.  If you are not comfortable asking for assistance, this is not the position for you.  We will make ourselves available to you frequently to support you. Our program works, and we have data that shows we have the lowest r ---------- rate of all available programs.  Currently, we have 16,000 people a year take our program.  We want people to use our program because it saves lives. Our company’s founder lost her infant child to an impaired driver and she developed this program to be an inspiration for change because showing compassion is truly how we help people do better.  We do not subscribe to the idea that you can shame or punish away bad behavior and this is reflected in how we interact with customers.

title: Maintenance Coordinator - Bilingual
description: PSB (Pro Services Boston) and Green Ocean Property Management are integrated maintenance + property management teams serving the Greater Boston market. We manage multifamily, single-family, and HOA assets and run an in-house service operation focused on speed, quality, and clear communication. Role Overview: The Maintenance Coordinator is the command center for all work orders: intake, triage, scheduling, vendor coordination, tenant communications, and close-out. You’ll prioritize urgent issues, keep preventive maintenance on cadence, and drive down cycle times. This is a performance role with clear SLAs, daily accountability rhythms, and growth into senior coordination/ops leadership. Core Responsibilities: Work Order Intake & Triage Receive requests via portal/phone/email; log with complete scope, photos, access info, and priority tag. Classify by Priority (P0–P3) and building/owner rules; verify warranty/recall/recurring issues. Pre-diagnose to reduce truck rolls (simple resets, filter sizes, breaker checks, shutoff guidance). Scheduling & Dispatch Assign to the right vendor/tech based on trade, SLA, geography, availability, and cost. Build and update daily/weekly schedules; confirm tenant access, lockbox codes, pet/alarms, parking. Create and track Not-to-Exceed (NTE) amounts; obtain approvals when required. Vendor Management Coordinate licensed vendors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance, roofing, etc.). Ensure COI/W-9/licenses are current; validate arrival/completion, photo proof, and written diagnosis. Request quotes for >NTE jobs; compare scope/price; route to approval. Tenant & Owner Communication Provide clear ETAs, prep steps (water shutoff, clearing access), and progress updates. Set expectations for parts lead times and follow-ups; confirm satisfaction at completion. Escalate sensitively when work impacts health/safety or habitability. Preventive Maintenance (PM) Maintain seasonal PM calendars (boilers/furnaces, gutters, dryer vents, smoke/CO checks, filter changes). Batch/schedule PMs to minimize tenant disruption and travel time; track completion. Invoicing & Close-Out Ensure work orders have diagnosis, materials, labor, before/after photos, and time stamps. Match invoices to WOs, verify against NTE, route exceptions, and submit to accounting the same day. Emergencies & After-Hours Coordination Follow the P0/P1 emergency SOP (gas/water/electrical hazards, no-heat, lockouts). Coordinate on-call vendors, city services, and temporary mitigation. Reporting & Quality Produce daily/weekly reports on SLA adherence, WIP aging, cost variance, and vendor performance. Flag repeat issues, recommend root-cause fixes (access hardware, part stocking, vendor changes). Qualifications: Fluent in English and Spanish language Maintenance coordinating experience in a US Property Management company is a must Knowledgeable in construction engineering is a plus Has excellent problem solving skill Good communication skills in English Outstanding skills in organizing schedules Experience with property management software Buildium/Property Meld is a plus Self-driven and can work with little supervision Extremely organized and can work in a constantly changing and fast past environment Want to have a stable career with endless potential for learning and growth Able to work on EST Business hours IF YOU ARE NOT A BILINGUAL MAINTENANCE COORDINATOR- Please do not Apply or you will not be entertained. Thank you

You do not wait for things to come to you. You go after them. Monthly rate: $400/month + Performance Bonus (paid via Wise). Expected hours: 30-40 hours per week. Additional Signing bonus: $50 paid on successful completion of your 30-day trial. Performance bonuses (paid monthly, on top of base): These are earned on proactive activity only — leads you followed up on without being asked, or new enquiries you qualified and moved through the pipeline to a close. Responding to an inbound email is part of the job. Converting it by going the extra mile is what earns commission. • $50 for any proactively converted sale or qualified lead that closes under £10,000 • $100 for any proactively converted sale or qualified lead that closes above £10,000 There is no cap on performance bonuses. A strong month with multiple proactive conversions can bring total earnings well above the base. The ceiling is entirely determined by your output. Growth and Learning — This Is Not an Ordinary VA Role We are building Aurora to run on AI. That means the person in this role will become one of the most AI-capable operators in their field — not by a ---------- , but because we will invest in that deliberately. What this looks like in practice: • You will use Claude and ChatGPT daily. We will help you get better at it, not just tell you to use them. You will learn prompting, automation, and AI-assisted research to a level that makes you genuinely rare in the market. • We document everything and build playbooks together. You will not just do tasks — you will help build the systems that run this business. • Promotion is real. We are looking for someone who becomes a Communications Lead, then an Operations Lead, and eventually a business operator who runs a significant part of Aurora independently. • We treat this as a long-term relationship. Our goal is to give you the skills, tools, and exposure that a typical job never would — the kind of experience that makes you a genuine business operator, not just an employee. If you are looking for a quiet inbox job, this is not it. If you want to grow into someone who understands sales, operations, AI tools, supplier relationships, and premium e-commerce — and you want a founder who will put real effort into developing you — this role was built for that. title: Digital Marketing Operations Assistant - Facebook/Meta
description: We are looking for a detail-oriented Digital Marketing Operations Assistant to set up, organize, and manage the technical foundation needed for digital advertising campaigns. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working inside Meta Business Suite, Ads Manager, tracking tools, CRM systems, websites, and marketing platforms to ensure accounts are properly configured and ready for campaign launch. Responsibilities As a Digital Marketing Operations Assistant, you will be responsible for setting up and configuring digital marketing accounts, with a strong focus on Meta platforms including Facebook and Instagram. This includes creating and organizing Meta Business Manager accounts, ad accounts, Facebook Pages, Instagram business accounts, payment methods, user permissions, partner access, pixels, datasets, events, and related business assets. You will connect and verify key assets such as websites, domains, Meta Pixels, conversion events, catalogs, lead forms, CRM integrations, landing pages, and tracking tools. You will ensure accounts are structured correctly, secure, compliant, and ready for advertising campaigns. You will set up and test conversion tracking, configure standard and custom events, assist with domain verification, review event matching quality, and confirm that tracking is working properly before campaigns go live. You may also assist with connecting Meta tools to platforms such as Shopify, WordPress, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Zapier, or other marketing systems. You will troubleshoot technical issues related to account access, permissions, billing, disabled assets, pixel installation, event tracking, rejected setup items, CRM connections, lead form delivery, and platform configuration. You will document completed setup steps, flag missing information, and clearly communicate what is ready, what is pending, and what needs action from the client or internal team. This role may also support basic campaign preparation, including naming conventions, audience setup, lead form setup, tracking links, UTM parameters, and campaign launch checklists. The primary focus is making sure the marketing infrastructure is clean, accurate, and ready for successful paid media execution. Requirements The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Meta Business Suite, Meta Business Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, Facebook Pages, Instagram business accounts, Meta Pixel, Events Manager, domain verification, business verification, ad account setup, billing setup, and user permissions. Candidates should understand how digital marketing assets connect together, including businesses, pages, ad accounts, pixels, datasets, domains, websites, lead forms, CRMs, landing pages, and partner access. Experience troubleshooting access issues, tracking problems, billing setup, pixel installation, event testing, and platform configuration issues is required. Strong attention to detail, organization, communication skills, and the ability to follow setup checklists are essential. Candidates should be comfortable working with clients, internal tea ---------- mbers, developers, and media buyers to gather access, resolve blockers, and prepare accounts for campaign launch. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Shopify, WordPress, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Zapier, landing page builders, email marketing platforms, or CRM integrations is preferred. Basic knowledge of paid advertising campaigns, especially Facebook and Instagram ads, custom audiences, lead forms, retargeting, catalogs, and conversion campaigns is a plus. Meta Blueprint certification, Google Analytics certification, or other marketing technology certifications are preferred but not required. About You You are organized, careful, and technically comfortable working across marketing platforms. You understand that successful campaigns depend on clean setup, accurate tracking, proper permissions, and reliable systems. You are good at spotting missing pieces, solving setup issues, and making sure everything is properly connected before campaigns go live. You communicate clearly, document your work, and help create a strong operational foundation for digital marketing success.

description: Position Overview We’re a growing Melbourne-based SEO agency hiring a full-time Content Operations Manager to own our SEO content production pipeline end-to-end — from keyword assignment ? brief creation ? writer management ? QA ? publishing coordination ? indexation + post-publish checks. This is NOT a writing role. You may occasionally rewrite lines during QA, but your core job is operations: make sure content ships, ships correctly, and ships on time across multiple clients. You will manage copywriters and VAs, coordinate with developers/publishers, run structured QA, handle client approvals, and keep production dashboards accurate. What You’ll Own (Responsibilities) A) Briefs + Production Management -Build SEO content briefs from assigned keywords (service pages + supporting content) using a consistent template. -Assign work to copywriters, manage deadlines, and unblock writers fast. -Maintain a visible production pipeline (status, owner, due dates, blockers). B) QA (Editorial + SEO + Retrieval-Friendly Formatting) -Coordinate VA first-pass QA, then complete a strict final QA before anything ships. -Enforce on-page fundamentals: title tag, H1, meta description, internal linking, headings, intent match. -Enforce AI-friendly formatting (direct answer blocks, scannable sections, tables where relevant) C) Publishing Coordination + “Definition of Done” -Brief developers/publishers with clear requirements (URL, metadata, internal links, schema, layout notes). -Validate pages before go ---------- formatting, links, layout, mobile UX, canonical correctness. -Indexation workflow: submit for indexing and monitor in Google Search Console (and flag issues fast). -“Done” means: published + accessible + internal links added + schema validated + indexing requested + tracked. D) Structured Data (Schema) -Specify and QA schema requirements (Service / LocalBusiness / Article / FAQ) and validate it. -You do not need to be a developer, but you must confidently manage schema tasks E) Client Approvals + Revisions -Manage client approval rounds clearly (what changed, what needs review, deadlines). -Consolidate feedback, route revision requests, and prevent endless cycles with strong briefs + guardrails. Tools / Stack (What we use) -PM: Asana (or similar) -Docs: Google Drive -CMS: WordPress -SEO/content tools: Surfer (or equivalent), GSC, Grammarly -AI-assisted workflows: ChatGPT / Claude -Originality checks: Originality.ai (experience preferred) If you haven’t used one tool but can demonstrate mastery of the workflow, we still want to talk. What Success Looks Like (90-Day Outcomes) -You can run 11 clients concurrently without losing track of deadlines or quality. -Content is shipped with consistent QA, minimal rewrites, and clean approval cycles. -Publishing handoffs are clear; dev/publisher questions go down. -Pages are consistently indexed and tracked; issues are flagged early. Must-Haves -Strong written/spoken English (non-negotiable). -Proven experience running content production in an agency setting (multi-client). -Extremely high attention to detail (daily QA). -Strong on-page SEO fundamentals and internal linking judgement. -Comfortable coordinating multiple roles (writers, VA, dev/publisher, account manager). Nice-to-Haves -Schema implementation/QA experience. -Experience building briefs that enforce direct answers + extractable formatting (AI retrieval readiness). -Familiarity with Surfer SEO for brief building and content scoring How to Apply Please start your application with the phrase "BLUE MANAGER" — applications without this will not be considered. Then complete our screening form: [ ---------- ] We will only consider candidates who submit the form. Selected candidates will complete a short paid test exercise before any hire decision is made. What We Offer -$10 USD per hour — full-time 40 hours per week -Paid on time every time — fortnightly or monthly your choice -Performance review at 60–90 days — raise to $12/hr based on QA accuracy and pipeline throughput -Access to a world-class SEO system and SOP library — you'll work inside one of the most structured content production environments available, with step-by-step processes for every stage of the pipeline. This isn't a "figure it out yourself" agency -Real growth path — as you master the content ops role there is a clear path into broader SEO responsibilities for the right person -Direct communication with the agency owner -All tools and access provided from day one -Long-term stable role with a fast-growing Melbourne agency Working Hours -Full-time: 40 hours per week -Flexible schedule (we can discuss your preferred hours) -Must have some overlap with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST) Our Hiring Process -Application review — form + code word + QA checklist -5-minute intro call — personal fit -15-minute technical interview — pipeline and operations knowledge -Paid test exercise — real work, scoped to 60–90 minutes -Offer to the right candidate Important Notes -This is NOT a writing role — you manage the pipeline, not the copy -This is NOT project-based — it is a permanent full-time position -We provide full SOP documentation, tools, and training -Looking to hire immediately for the right person If you're process-driven, detail-obsessed, and thrive in a fast-moving agency environment — we want to hear from you.

title: Podcast Manager/Editor/Virtual Assistant
description: I'm looking for someone to take ownership of my podcast and help turn it into a consistent content and growth engine for my business. The Master Your Mix Podcast is a weekly show focused on helping rock musicians, producers, and audio engineers create professional-quality recordings from their home studios. The podcast breaks down real-world recording, mixing, and production techniques in a practical way, with a strong focus on workflow, decision-making, and getting consistent results. Episodes feature conversations with top-level engineers and producers, designed to help listeners improve their mixes and recordings. Past guests include engineers and producers such as Andrew Scheps, Sylvia Massy, David Bendeth, and Barrett Jones (bonus points if you include his episode number in your application). We release 1 episode per week (4–5 per month, approximately 1 hour long each), and each episode is repurposed into multiple pieces of content across email , social, and video platforms. Who We Are: MasterYourMix is a music education business built around helping home studio musicians and producers get professional results from their recordings and mixes. The core belief is that great results don't require an expensive studio — they require the right process. The business includes educational courses, a coaching program (Amplitude), and a line of audio plugins under the Carve Audio brand. The podcast is the primary content channel that drives awareness, builds trust with the audience, and feeds into the broader product ecosystem. The host, Mike Indovina, is a mixing and mastering engineer with major label credits (Sony, Universal, Roadrunner, Republic, and others), a two-time #1 bestselling Amazon author, and a drummer. The show has featured some of the most respected engineers and producers in the industry. This role exists to keep that content engine running and growing. Compensation & Hours: • $400 USD/month This is a part-time role averaging approximately 10 hours per week. That said, someone who builds smart systems and uses AI tools effectively may find the workload becomes lighter over time — that efficiency is encouraged, not penalized. What You'll Be Responsible For: Guest Pipeline & Outreach • Identify and research potential guests in music production, mixing, and audio engineering • Conduct outreach and manage communication • Handle scheduling and follow-ups • Maintain a pipeline of upcoming guests to ensure consistent weekly releases The goal is to always have a steady flow of strong, relevant guests lined up. Episode Research & Prep • Research confirmed guests (credits, past interviews, workflows, etc.) • Identify interesting angles and topics for the conversation • Prepare simple briefing notes and talking points The goal is to make each episode focused, engaging, and useful for listeners. Episode Production • Edit episodes (currently we edit in Descript, though I'm open to alternate options as long as the quality is good). The podcast is available in both video and audio formats. • Clean up audio (leveling, basic EQ/compression, removing distractions) • Insert intro/outro and promotional segments • Export final episodes Publishing & Distribution • Upload and schedule episodes in Captivate • Publish episodes on the website using WordPress • Upload episodes and clips to YouTube • Ensure formatting, links, and presentation are consistent across all platforms • Preparing/publishing social media posts Content Repurposing • Identify strong ---------- nts from each episode • Create short-form clips (audiograms and/or video clips) • Write captions tailored to musicians and producers • Help turn each episode into multiple pieces of content Each episode should generate multiple content assets, not just a single upload. Email Marketing • Write weekly email s promoting each episode that address common issues home studio musicians experience and how the episode will help listeners solve them • Schedule email s inside Drip • Ensure each episode gets proper visibility with the audience Analytics & Optimization • Track performance of episodes, email s, and content • Identify what topics and clips perform best • Suggest improvements over time Monetization & Growth Opportunities • Identify potential monetization opportunities: •  Sponsors •  Partnerships •  Affiliate opportunities • Help integrate existing offers into the podcast: •  Coaching program (Amplitude) •  Courses •  Plugins • Suggest ways to improve how the podcast contributes to overall business growth What I'm Looking For: • Understanding of music production, mixing, or audio engineering: You need to know what will resonate with this audience. You don't have to be a professional engineer, but you should be able to speak the language. • Strong content instincts: You can identify what makes a great clip, hook, or angle. You think about content from the audience's perspective, not just the logistics of publishing. • AI fluency: You're already using AI tools as part of your workflow — for research, writing, repurposing content, or speeding up repetitive tasks. You don't need to be an expert, but this should be a natural part of how you work. • Clear, natural writing ability: Strong written and spoken English is required. Email s, captions, and show notes should feel human and direct — not corporate or generic. • Organized and reliable: Deadlines matter. A weekly podcast means a real weekly schedule. Things need to get done on time without being chased. • Ownership mentality: You'll have full autonomy over your workflow. What matters is that work gets done on time and to a consistent standard. I'm not going to check in on you daily — you'll be expected to manage your own schedule, stay ahead of the pipeline, and flag issues before they become problems. Bonus (Nice to Have) • Experience editing podcasts or working in Descript • Experience with WordPress • Experience creating short-form video content (Reels, Shorts, etc.) • Experience with email marketing platforms like Drip • Familiarity with YouTube publishing and basic optimization • Familiarity with graphic design tools like Canva How Success Is Measured • A consistent pipeline of upcoming guests (no scheduling gaps) • Weekly episodes released on time • Each episode produces multiple pieces of content across email , social, and video • Email s are sent consistently and drive engagement • Ongoing improvement in content performance over time • The podcast fuels monetary goals What This Role Is NOT • Not just a podcast editing role • Not just a virtual assistant checking boxes • Not a position where you wait to be told what to do You'll be expected to think, contribute ideas, and improve the process over time. To Apply: Please include: 1. Examples of content you've worked on — podcasts, clips, email s, social posts, anything relevant 2. A brief introduction about your experience and why this role interests you Applications that show genuine familiarity with the show and audience will stand out. You don't need to listen to a full episode, but it should be clear you took a few minutes to actually look.
