description: WHO WE ARE We are a US-based direct-to-consumer supplement brand scaling aggressively on Meta. We currently do $300K+/month in revenue across Shopify and Checkout Champ, with a monthly recurring subscription program driving significant MRR. Our backend is already systemized — AI-powered email automation, structured SOPs, established supplier relationships, and a two-person leadership team (Founder/CEO + Brand Manager) who are actively building this into an eight-figure brand. This is not a startup figuring things out. This is a scaling machine that needs a qualified operator to own the backend. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We need an E-Commerce Operations Manager — not a virtual assistant, not someone who "wants to learn e-commerce." We need someone who has BEEN the backend operator at a DTC brand doing at least $100K/month on Shopify. Someone who already knows what it feels like when 200+ orders come in per day and things need to run perfectly. Someone who has processed refunds at 11pm to prevent a chargeback. Someone who has built a daily PNL from scratch in Google Sheets. Someone who has monitored payment gateway approval rates and knows what a MID is. If that's not you, please do not apply. We respect your time and ours. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Customer Operations (Escalated Tickets Only) We have full AI automation handling tier-one customer email s (where's my order, product questions, general inquiries). Your job is NOT answering email s all day. Your job is handling the 10-20% of tickets that get escalated to a human — refunds, subscription cancellations, chargeback threats, angry customers, and anything requiring account access or judgment. Maximum 12-hour response time on escalated tickets. Chargebacks are the #1 threat to our business. You need to understand this in your bones. Financial Reporting & Analytics You own the daily PNL. Every single day, you pull revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, net profit, and unit economics into Google Sheets. You track subscription metrics — new enrollments, cancellations, churn rate, MRR. You monitor average order value, chargeback rate, and gateway approval rates. You flag anomalies before anyone has to ask. If revenue drops 30% on a random Tuesday, we should hear it from you first — not discover it ourselves. Operational Oversight & Brand Monitoring You monitor order fulfillment and tracking daily. You check our comment moderation platform (BrandWise) every single day — reviewing every comment on every ad, hiding negative comments, flagging trends, and reporting on brand sentiment. You monitor payment processing health across multiple MIDs and flag any issues with approval rates, reserves, or underwriting requests. You communicate with our fulfillment supplier when needed. You are the person who catches problems before they become emergencies. THE TOOLS WE USE You don't need to know every tool on this list — but you need to know most of them, and you'll be trained on the rest. description: Summary We're a fast-growing Dutch brand making custom branded merchandise for pilates and fitness studios worldwide. Our products ship under multiple labels, manufactured across several factories in Asia. We're a small, ambitious team and we work hard, have fun doing it, and take real pride in what we build together. We're looking for someone who fits that same energy. What this role is This is a Virtual Assistant role, but not the kind where you respond to email s and update spreadsheets on autopilot. We need someone talented, proactive, and detail-obsessed who can own two key pillars of our daily operations without hand-holding: customer service and supplier coordination. This starts as a part-time role of 4 to 5 hours per day, spread across 5 days a week. Our ambition is to grow it into a full-time position as the business scales, so we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us, not just fill a slot. Your responsibilities You start your day with customer service. Our clients are fitness and pilates studios around the world, and everything we make is custom. Supplier coordination is the second core of this role. You'll be in daily contact with our factories, primarily via WeChat, following up on production status, confirming timelines, and keeping our tracking sheets accurate. You'll forward production orders from our internal team to the correct suppliers with the correct files. Errors here have real consequences, so precision matters. I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company. If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply: REQUIRED EXPERIENCE: - Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar & Email Management, etc) You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to email & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language -- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software - 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram, Facebook , Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus - Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-) - Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and email service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc) ABOUT YOU: - “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable. - Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects. - You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months. - You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth - You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving. - Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday. - You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources. - You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for. If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply. PERKS: I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in: - Task & Calendar Management - Launch/Sales Strategy Planning - Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses) - Social Media Management - Digital Media Marketing (Including Email and SMS Marketing) - Lead Generation After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include: - Part time work hours - Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast) - Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual) - Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn) Interested? Quality USB headset with a noise-cancelling microphone Modern computer (Windows or Mac, less than 5 years old) Available 9:00am–5:00pm US Eastern Time, Monday–Friday. ID Proof verified on your OnlineJobs.ph profile — we only review applications from ID-verified accounts. Nice to have You've worked for a small US-based e-commerce brand answering US customers, and those customers never realized you weren't based in the US. This is the experience we care about most. Familiarity with any customer service or e-commerce tools (Richpanel, helpdesks, e-comm platforms, email tools) — list anything you've used Other work skills that could help a small company — bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, anything you do well We'll watch your video and read your application. If we like you, we'll reach out. At that point we'll ask you to obtain an NBI Clearance — we'll reimburse the fee. Schedule Full-time, 40 hours per week Paid twice monthly Long-term role — we're hiring carefully because we want to grow with the right person How to apply (please read carefully — incomplete applications will not be reviewed) In your email , please include all 6 items below. We sort applications by who followed every instruction — not by who applied first. At the very top of your email , write the word “Buddy” in bold. (This is so we know you read all the way to the end of this post.) Tell us in 2–3 sentences: are you a dog person? Why? Record a 1–3 minute video covering the four prompts described below, and get it to us any way you want — attach the file, paste a YouTube unlisted link, Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer, anything that works. Attach a screenshot of a current speedtest.net result showing your download speed, upload speed, and ping. In the email , also tell us what internet plan you have at home and whether you're on a wired Ethernet connection or WiFi. List any customer service, e-commerce, admin, or office software / tools you have used (for example: Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout, Shopify, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, QuickBooks, Google Workspace — anything you actually know). List one or more previous employers who can speak to how good your customer service is. The more the better — but one is fine if that's all you have. Video prompts (1–3 minutes total, single take, no editing) Please cover all four of the following in your video, in any order you like. There's no script — just talk to us like you'd talk to a customer. Introduce yourself. Your first name, where you live in the Philippines, and one thing about you that's not on your resume. Tell us about your customer service background. Where you've worked, who your customers were, and — especially — what your phone customer service experience has been like. What kinds of calls did you handle? How often were you on the phone? What were your callers like? Why this role? Tell us what you're looking for in your next job and why customer service for US pet owners feels like a fit for you. What else can you do? Customer service is the main job — but a person with extra skills is gold to a small team like ours. If there's another work skill you have that could help our company (bookkeeping, admin, writing, social media, scheduling, etc.), tell us briefly about it. If customer service is your only area, just say so — that's a fine answer. Tips: Record in a quiet room. Audio clarity matters more than video quality. Use your phone or webcam. We want to hear the real you. 1 minute minimum, 3 minutes maximum. Going under or over is a soft red flag — it tells us how you'd manage time on a real call. If your application is missing any of items 1–6, or if your video is over 5 minutes or under 1 minute, we will not review it. title: $10/hour: Customer Service + Strategy/Operations VA
description: Hi, I'm Andrew, I'm looking for a coachable long-term VA who'll grow with the business. The deal: - $10 USD/hour via Hubstaff, growing as the role grows - Paid every 2 weeks via Wise, on time - Pro-rated 13th month bonus every December - Long-term role with growing hours and responsibilities - Paid 2-week trial period before formal long-term hiring The role starts at ~14 hrs/week, growing to full-time as we scale, and eventually leading other VAs and making executive decisions yourself as you become essential to the business. Schedule: ~2 hours/day including weekends. Flexible on when you work, but customer email s should get a response within 24 hours. ~70% customer service and email work, ~30% growing into strategic work (brand partnerships, research, ops) What you'll do: - Reply to customer email s (tracking, returns, refunds, disputes, chargebacks) - Respond to social media messages, comments, and inquiries - Use Shopify daily (orders, gift cards, collaborator account access) - Help coordinate brand collaborations and partnerships - Coordinate with suppliers on order issues - Communicate with me daily via WhatsApp (async, I don't expect instant replies) - Update Google Sheets with various research projects - Take on new responsibilities as the business grows Hard skills required: - Excellent written English - Experience replying to customers via email and social media - Comfortable using Shopify (or willing to learn quickly) - Reliable internet and quiet workspace Soft skills required: - Highly coachable: I'll teach you a lot, SOPs, brand voice, workflows. You need to learn fast and ask good questions. - Detail-oriented: small mistakes in customer email s cost money - Proactive: flag things to me before they become problems - Comfortable pushing back when something doesn't make sense How to apply: No skills test, no essay. Just message me the link to one Loom video, covering these things: 1. About yourself (experience with customer service, Shopify, etc..) Basically why I should hire you and how you fit this role. 2. One thing that actually makes you you (a weird hobby, a strong opinion, your worst cooking disaster, anything but "I love organizing things") 3. The hardest customer situation you've ever dealt with, and what you actually did about it 4. A customer is furious their package is late and threatening to chargeback, walk me through how you'd handle them. Pretend you are the CEO, you can do anything you'd like. Impress me rather than just saying "apologize and I will follow up." One real ask: don't run this through ChatGPT and read it off a script. I can tell instantly, it's painfully obvious, and it looks exactly like every other application. I'd genuinely rather watch you fumble through a real answer than nail a robotic one. Be a person, get creative, go off-script. There are no rules here, I just want it from the heart. I will watch every single loom, impress me, be different, and be creative!

description: We are a category-leading women’s eCommerce brand on a mission to create premium, affordable, and 100% waterproof jewelry that enhances our customers’ everyday lives. We’ve served over 1,000,000 customers worldwide in more than 145 countries! We’re hiring one or more sharp, proactive Administrative Assistants to support operations and execution across the business. This is not a “basic VA role.” If you need reminders, struggle with details, or prefer slow-paced work, this role will not be a fit. We are looking for someone who is: • fast, organized, and detail-obsessed • proactive (you spot issues before being asked) • fluent in Notion (databases + task systems + SOPs) • fluent in Shopify (orders + products + inventory fields) • able to work reliably with Dubai time (Gulf Standard Time, UTC+4) Working Hours (Dubai Time Requirement) This is a full-time role with consistent daily coverage. To be considered, you must have consistent availability in Dubai time (UTC+4). Required working hours: 8 am – 4 pm Dubai time (UTC+4), Monday–Friday. Please do not apply if you cannot reliably cover these hours. What You’ll Own (Core Responsibilities) 1) Operations Execution + Coordination • Maintain internal task systems in Notion (databases, assignees, due dates, SOPs) • Support daily operations tracking (orders, stock, shipments, urgent issues) • Create structure: checklists, templates, and systems to keep execution clean 2) Shopify Admin Support • Process and monitor orders, returns, and exchanges • Update product listings and key Shopify admin fields accurately • Maintain operational accuracy across inventory / pricing / product details (basic Shopify fluency is required — this is not optional) 3) Admin & Team Support • Scheduling, calendar coordination, meeting agendas, notes, follow-ups • Document management, data entry, reporting, and structured file organization • Ensure tasks don’t slip through cracks (high ownership required) • You will be expected to spot problems, propose solutions, and keep execution moving without needing constant direction Additional Support Areas (As Needed) This is primarily an operations + admin role. title: Customer Support + Social Media VA for Dog Mobility Brand (Long-Term, Claude AI Required)
job_title: Customer Support + Social Media VA for Dog Mobility Brand (Long-Term, Claude AI Required)
description: Customer Support + Social Media VA for Fast-Growing Dog Mobility Brand (Long-Term, Career Role) Pay: Starting $120/week, with raises based on performance and growing scale. We have a clear track record of paying our team more as we grow — this is not a "stuck at $120/week forever" role. Hours: This is NOT an hourly tracked role. This is a response-time and coverage role. You will not be working 24 hours a day, but you must check in on support channels consistently throughout the day, every day, including weekends. Most critical activity window: 9 AM – 5 PM US Mountain / Arizona Time (no daylight saving — Phoenix-based). You must be most active during these hours, with lighter check-ins outside. Type: Full-time, long-term. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with our brand for YEARS, not someone applying to 30 jobs this week. READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING We will instantly delete any application that does not follow the instructions at the bottom. No exceptions. If you cannot follow instructions in a job post, you cannot follow our SOPs as an employee. Why This Role Is Different Most VA roles are clock-in, clock-out, answer-the-tickets work. This one is not. You will be operating as an extension of our brand brain. We will provide you with your own seat on our Claude AI Team workspace — pre-loaded with brand-specific Projects, voice guidelines, policies, and templates we have built. You will use Claude at an advanced level to draft responses faster than humanly possible and operate at a level most VAs can't touch. We don't expect you to type every email from scratch — that's a waste of your talent. We expect you to MASTER Claude, contribute to our Projects, and use it as a force multiplier on every single customer interaction. You do not need your own Claude subscription — we provide it. But you must already know how to use Claude at an advanced level before applying. We are not training someone on Claude from zero. If you are AI-fluent and ambitious, this is one of the most interesting VA roles you will ever find. If you think AI is just "ChatGPT for grammar," this is not your role. About Us We are Wag Wize — a fast-scaling dog mobility brand helping dogs with disabilities, injuries, and aging conditions live better lives. We are in year 2, growing fast, and have built a strong operational foundation. We are NOT a startup trying to figure things out. We know what we're doing, we know what good work looks like, and we hold our team to a high standard. Our customers are emotional dog owners going through hard times. Many are scared, grieving, or frustrated about their dog's condition — and sometimes they take that pain out on us. Your job is to stay warm, calm, and understanding with every single one of them — even the rude ones — while still holding firm to our policies. We are a profitable business that must remain profitable to keep helping dogs, and our policies exist for a reason. This is hard work. It is also deeply meaningful. You will help dogs and their families every single day. What You'll Actually Do Customer Support (50% of role): Manage all incoming support tickets in Gorgias (email , live chat, contact form) Use Claude to draft responses that are warm, on-brand, and policy-compliant — never generic, never copy-pasted templates that feel robotic Hold firm to our policies while being empathetic. We do not give every customer everything they want. We follow policy. When a customer refuses to accept our policy, we politely end the conversation and stop wasting time. Handle and prevent chargebacks — respond to disputes with documentation, and prevent disputes by resolving issues before they escalate Escalate the right things to us — and handle the rest without needing to ask Social Media Moderation (40% of role): Monitor Facebook and Instagram comments and ---------- all day Hide or delete negative/harmful comments quickly — but ALWAYS reach out to the commenter privately to attempt resolution Reply to positive comments to build community Respond to DMs within minutes during US daytime This is HIGH-VISIBILITY work. A negative comment sitting publicly for 2 hours costs us conversions. Brand Growth Initiatives (10% of role — and this is where you earn raises): Proactively reach out to happy customers and ask them to share their dog's story and video content with us. This is HIGH ROI for the brand. We use this content on our website and social media for social proof and trust. Identify patterns in customer issues and report them to us so we can fix root causes Help maintain and improve our Claude Projects with brand knowledge so our entire support system gets smarter over time Bring ideas. Be creative. Add value to the brand beyond just answering tickets. REQUIRED Experience (Non-Negotiable) If you do not have ALL of the following, please do not apply: Claude (Anthropic AI) — Advanced level — You use Claude regularly, you understand prompting, you know how to use Projects, you know how to feed context, and you know how to guide Claude to produce on-brand output. "I've tried ChatGPT" does NOT qualify. We provide the account, but you must already be fluent. We will test this in the interview. Gorgias — You have used Gorgias as a support agent before. Not "I've heard of it." Actual hands-on experience. Shopify — You have worked in a Shopify admin panel before, can issue refunds, look up orders, check fulfillment status, etc. Brand social media management — You have managed Facebook and Instagram for a real business before. Personal account experience does not count. We need someone who knows how to hide comments, moderate DMs, and represent a brand voice. Chargeback handling — You have submitted chargeback disputes through Shopify, Stripe, or PayPal before. You know what documentation to attach. DTC ecommerce experience — You have worked for an ecommerce brand before, not just a generic call center. Excellent written English — Customers should never be able to tell you are not a native speaker. Your grammar, tone, and warmth must be flawless. Pet/dog industry experience is a strong plus but not required. Who We Are NOT Looking For Anyone who needs to be told what to do every day Anyone who cuts corners or sends generic copy-paste replies Anyone who lets rude customers fluster them or push them around Anyone who lets rude customers get their way just to end the conversation Anyone who treats this like a 9-5 they clock in and out of Anyone who is applying to 20 other jobs and will leave in 3 months Anyone who can't take direct, honest feedback Anyone who thinks AI is a fad or "cheating" We had a previous VA who did the bare minimum and hid behind appearing busy. We caught it and we will catch it again. We monitor everything. We hold everyone accountable, including ourselves. If you are not someone who genuinely wants to work hard and grow a brand, you will not last here and we will both waste each other's time. Who We ARE Looking For Someone who treats customer communication as a passion, not a task Someone who is warm and patient even with the rudest customers Someone who is firm and confident in our policies — never apologetic for following them Someone who notices things and brings them up without being asked Someone who is genuinely excited about helping dogs live better lives Someone who wants ONE long-term role they grow into, not a stepping stone Someone hungry, ambitious, and self-driven — the same energy you bring to applying, you bring every day for years Someone who is genuinely excited about AI and using it to operate at a higher level than other VAs What We Provide Your own seat on our Claude AI Team workspace, pre-loaded with brand-specific Projects Gorgias access with full training on our setup Shopify access (limited to your role) Direct mentorship from our team during the trial period and beyond Clear, fair feedback — always A real career path with raises tied to performance and scale Trial Period The first 2 weeks are a paid trial at the full $120/week rate ($240 total for 2 weeks). During the trial, you will work directly with our current team to learn our systems, voice, and standards. If the trial goes well, you continue full-time. If it does not, we part ways respectfully. How To Apply (READ CAREFULLY) To be considered, your application MUST include ALL of the following, in this exact order: Start your application with the word "MOBILITY" as the first word of your message. Applications that do not start with this word will be deleted without reading. Answer these 6 questions in your application, numbered: Which Shopify-based brand(s) have you supported, and for how long? What Gorgias features have you used (macros, rules, tags, integrations, etc.)? Describe one time you handled a chargeback dispute. What was the outcome? Describe one time you had to firmly tell a customer "no" while keeping them calm. What did you say? How do you currently use Claude in your work? Describe a specific workflow where Claude saves you significant time. Be specific — generic answers will be rejected. What's the difference between using Claude Projects vs. a regular Claude chat, and when would you use each? Share a writing sample. Either paste below OR send a link to: A real reply you wrote to an upset customer (you can change names/details for privacy) OR write a fresh sample: imagine a customer just email ed us saying their dog's wheelchair arrived and the wheels won't roll properly, they're furious because their dog is suffering, and they're demanding a full refund + return shipping. Write the reply. Send links to 1-2 brand social accounts you have managed (Facebook or Instagram). If you cannot share due to NDA, explain what you did and provide a reference contact. Tell us: What hours (in US Mountain / Arizona Time) can you commit to being most active during? And what's your plan for coverage outside those hours? End your application with this sentence exactly: "I read the entire post and I am ready to grow with Wag Wize long-term." What Happens Next We read every application that follows the instructions above. We delete the rest. Top applicants receive a short unpaid skills task (15-20 min) to evaluate real work Top performers from the task move to a video interview One person is selected for the 2-week paid trial Trial graduates become full-time tea ---------- mbers We move fast. If you are a fit, expect a reply within 3-5 days. We are excited to find the right person. The right person will know it the ---------- nt they read this post. — The Wag Wize Team

title: Operations Coordinator (VA)
description: About Alpha Key Digital Alpha Key Digital is a digital marketing agency specializing in patient acquisition for cosmetic surgeons, dermatologists, medical spas, and cosmetic dentists. We’ve been in business for 10 years, serve 12 retainer clients, and are growing. We’re a small team that operates with precision. No bloat. No unnecessary meetings. Clear communication, clean systems, and work that gets done when it’s supposed to get done. We are looking for a Virtual Assistant to take operational, administrative, and coordination tasks off the founder’s plate so he can focus on client strategy, business development, and growth. This is a high-trust role. You will be the person who keeps the engine running behind the scenes. The Role: Virtual Assistant / Operations Coordinator. Full-time. Remote. Must have significant overlap with US Eastern business hours. You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks. The founder runs the client relationships and the strategy. You run the operational backbone that supports it: email triage, project management, scheduling, contractor coordination, content posting, and prospect list management. You don’t wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you close it. This is not a customer-facing role. You will not be talking to clients directly. You will be the person behind the curtain making sure every deliverable, every email , every task, and every calendar event is where it’s supposed to be so the founder can walk into any conversation fully prepared. You’d Be a Great Fit If You Are The person who builds the checklist before anyone asks for one. You organize by instinct, not because someone gave you a system to follow. You create the system. Reliable to the point where people stop checking your work because they already know it’s done. You don’t need reminders. You are the reminder. Someone who reads the full email before responding. You catch the detail in the third paragraph that everyone else misses. You ask the clarifying question before it becomes a problem. Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision. You don’t need daily check-ins to stay productive. You need clear expectations and then space to execute. Proactive about surfacing problems early. If something is off, you flag it immediately instead of hoping it resolves itself. You know the difference between handling it yourself and escalating it. Disciplined with time. You batch similar work together. You don’t context-switch 15 times a day. When you’re in a task, you finish it before moving on. Protective of other people’s calendars. You treat the founder’s schedule like a strategic asset, not a suggestion. If something doesn’t belong on the calendar, you say so. Someone who takes pride in clean systems. Your Asana is current. Your inbox is processed. Your files are named correctly. You don’t leave loose ends. What You Actually Do Email and Communication Management Triage the founder’s inbox daily. Flag urgent items, draft responses for routine email s, archive what doesn’t need attention. Manage Slack communication with the white-label development team (E2M) and contractors. Relay updates, follow up on late deliverables, keep threads organized. Ensure no email or message sits unanswered for more than 24 hours during business days. Project Management and Task Coordination Own Asana: create tasks from briefs, assign to the right team member, track deadlines, follow up on overdue items, and keep the board clean. Coordinate deliverables between the founder, PPC contractor, SEO team, and E2M web development team. You are the traffic controller. Run a weekly check on all active client projects to confirm nothing is behind schedule. Surface delays to the founder before the client notices. Calendar and Scheduling Manage the founder’s calendar. Schedule client meetings, prospect calls, internal huddles, and personal appointments. Protect time blocks. The founder has dedicated strategic work time that should not be interrupted by meetings. You enforce that. Confirm and send reminders for all meetings. No missed appointments. LinkedIn and Prospect List Management Schedule LinkedIn posts (batch-created by the founder) using a scheduling tool. Export connection lists from Ulinc (LinkedIn automation tool) and organize prospect data in spreadsheets. Maintain and clean prospect lists. Tag, sort, and update contact records as the outbound pipeline grows. Send LinkedIn event invitations to targeted lists for webinars (up to 1,000/week). Copy, paste, send. Content and Social Media Support Post pre-approved content to social media channels on schedule. You are not creating the content. You are making sure it goes live when it’s supposed to. Upload and schedule video content (case studies, testimonials) to appropriate platforms. Basic Canva edits for social media graphics if needed. Reporting Support Pull data from Google Looker Studio dashboards for monthly client reports. You are not analyzing the data. You are making sure the reports are assembled and ready for the founder to review. Track basic metrics the founder requests (Ulinc connection rates, LinkedIn post engagement, email open rates). What You Are Not Doing Talking to clients. The founder owns all client relationships until a Client Success Manager is hired. Setting strategy or making campaign decisions. You coordinate. You don’t decide. Financial work. No bookkeeping, invoicing, or payment processing. Writing original content, ad copy, or marketing strategy. You post and schedule what others create. You are the operational backbone that frees the founder to do the work only he can do. Qualifications Required Two or more years of experience as a virtual assistant, operations coordinator, or executive assistant supporting a founder or small team Proficiency in Asana or a comparable project management tool (ClickUp, Monday, Trello) Proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive, Calendar) Proficiency in Slack or a comparable team messaging tool Strong written English. Clear, professional, no errors. Reliable internet connection and a quiet, distraction-free workspace Available during US Eastern business hours (minimum 6 hours of overlap with 8am-5pm ET) Proven ability to work independently, manage your own time, and meet deadlines without being chased Preferred Experience supporting a digital marketing agency or a B2B service business Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and LinkedIn posting/scheduling Familiarity with Google Looker Studio (pulling reports, not building them) Experience with Canva for basic graphic edits Experience with Zapier or Make for workflow automation Familiarity with CRM tools (GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot, or similar) Experience coordinating with offshore or white-label teams across time zones Tools You Will Use Daily Asana: project and task management Gmail / Google Workspace: email , docs, sheets, calendar Slack: internal team communication LinkedIn: posting, scheduling, connection list management Ulinc: exporting connection data, managing prospect lists Weekly Google Looker Studio: pulling client reporting data Canva: basic social media graphic edits Zoom / Loom: scheduling and coordinating video calls and async video Compensation and Details Full-time position Remote (global, any location with reliable internet) Must have significant overlap with US Eastern business hours (minimum 6 hours, 8am-5pm ET) Compensation commensurate with experience and location Reports directly to the founder Start date: as soon as the right person is found How to Apply Apply at the link below. You will complete a short application form and then record video responses to 7 questions. The whole process takes about 15 minutes. ---------- Three things we look for in every application: Did you read the full job description? (We can tell.) Can you communicate clearly and professionally in writing? Do you show evidence of working independently without needing to be managed? Generic applications will not receive a response.

variation listings accurately • Ensure all item specifics are fully completed and compliant with eBay requirements • Manage listing content including titles, descriptions, pricing, images, shipping, and returns • Monitor listing performance and implement improvements where needed • Maintain accurate stock levels and availability • Ensure compliance with eBay listing policies and marketplace standards • Maintain clean, accurate, and commercially optimised listings Additional Requirements The successful candidate must demonstrate: • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy • Ability to optimisation • Products with variations (size, weight, bundles, multi-SKU structures) • Experience with physical goods such as fitness, bulky items, or multi-variant catalogues Working Hours Flexible A normal week might include: - "Hey, it's my mom's birthday on Tuesday, can you remind me and help me figure out what to send her" - Booking a haircut, a flight, or a dinner reservation - Sending thank you notes to customers who referred us - Finding a good gift for someone we barely know but should impress - Following up on email s the owner has been ignoring for 4 days - Researching things like "what's the best dog food for a golden retriever" or "who's the top-rated plumber supplier in this area" - Light inbox cleanup and calendar wrangling - Customer follow-ups, birthday and anniversary outreach - Buying random stuff on Amazon - Reminding the owner about the thing he said he would never forget but definitely forgot - Whatever else comes up If you read that list and thought "yes, I love this kind of variety," keep reading. If you thought "that's chaotic," this is not your role. WHO YOU ARE - Your English is clean and natural in writing and on the phone. You can write a birthday text that sounds like a real human, not a greeting card - You're resourceful. If you don't know how to do something, you figure it out instead of asking 12 follow-up questions - You're warm and friendly in your communication. People like getting messages from you - You're organized. You don't forget the thing you said you'd handle - You take initiative. If you see something that needs doing, you do it - Honest, discreet, and trustworthy with personal and business information - Comfortable with US culture, slang, and norms (this matters more than you'd think when you're sending texts to American clients and family) LOGISTICS - Full-time, 40 hours per week, US business hours (Eastern or Central, to be confirmed) - $5/hr USD to start, paid weekly - Quiet workspace, solid internet backup power, your own computer HOW TO APPLY We will get a lot of applications. To make this fair to both of us, follow these instructions exactly. Anything missing gets deleted. 1. Subject line: "SWISS ARMY - [your name]" 2. In one short paragraph, tell me about a time someone asked you to do something weird or random, and how you handled it. Doesn't have to be work. Write me a 2-sentence happy birthday message as if you were sending it on behalf of a US business owner to a long-time customer named Mike. Make it sound human, not corporate. Tell me about your favorite hobby or what you did this weekend. We want to hear how you sound and see your workspace. 6. Send a screenshot of your internet speed test. 7. Your earliest start date. Looking forward to meeting our person.

title: GUEST COMMUNICATION & AI OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE
description: ABOUT OODA OODA Management is a San Diego-based short-term rental property management company building the next generation of how short-term rentals are run. Short-term rental management is hard to scale. Every property is different, every guest is different, and every situation requires judgment. Most companies either deliver great personalized service at small scale, or they grow and the service quality quietly falls apart. We are building the company that does not make that trade. We are small and AI-native by design. We use AI tools, automation, and tight operating systems to deliver service at a level legacy property managers cannot match without hiring far more people. Guest communication is one of the most important parts of that system. This role starts with guest messaging, but the long-term opportunity is helping us build the guest communication engine of an AI-native property management company. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a guest communication role with an AI operations growth path. Your first responsibility is simple and important: make sure guests receive fast, clear, calm, professional support. You will respond to guest messages, follow SOPs, escalate issues, update internal systems, and help ensure guests feel taken care of during their stay. But this is not just a message-answering job. At OODA, every guest message is also a signal. A guest asks a confusing check-in question. Why was it confusing? A guest reports an issue late at night. What information do we need? A guest asks the same thing five other guests asked. Should we update the template? A situation keeps repeating. Should AI handle it next time? A message could have been prevented. What was missing from the instructions? We are looking for someone who can handle the guest professionally today, then help us make the system better tomorrow. You do not need to be a programmer. You do not need to have a deep technical background. But you should be comfortable with software, interested in AI tools, and excited to learn how automation can improve operations. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Most guest messaging jobs are simple: answer questions, follow scripts, close tickets. This is different. OODA is building a system where human judgment and AI work together. Guest communication is one of the main places where that happens. The person in this role will help us understand: What guests ask most often Which messages require human judgment Which messages can eventually be automated Where our instructions are confusing Where our SOPs need improvement Where AI responses are helpful Where AI responses need correction What information the team needs to make better decisions This role is for someone who wants to become excellent at guest communication and then help us build a smarter system around it. The starting point is guest support. The growth path is ownership. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your work may include: Responding to guest messages across Airbnb, property management tools, email , SMS, and other channels Answering questions about check-in, checkout, WiFi, parking, amenities, house rules, and property details Helping guests with access issues, unclear instructions, maintenance concerns, cleaning issues, and other stay-related problems Following SOPs and message templates while still sounding natural and human Keeping every conversation calm, clear, and professional Updating internal systems so the team knows what is happening Escalating maintenance, cleaning, access, or guest experience issues correctly Tracking repeated guest questions and recurring problems Helping improve message templates, SOPs, and internal notes Using AI tools like ChatGPT to draft, summarize, classify, and improve communication Reviewing AI-generated messages for accuracy, tone, and guest experience Helping identify which guest questions can be safely automated Helping train and refine AI-assisted guest communication over time You will not be expected to build software. But you should be excited to work inside a company where the goal is to make the system better every week. THE BIGGER OPPORTUNITY This role starts at 10 to 25 hours per week. We are starting part-time intentionally. The first phase is about learning our properties, tools, guest standards, SOPs, and escalation rules. For the right person, this can become full-time after the initial period. As OODA grows, the guest communication function will need people who can own more responsibility. That may mean expanded hours, team leadership, quality assurance, SOP ownership, AI training, guest messaging management, or a more specialized AI operations role. The best people in this function will not just answer messages. They will help define how guest communication should work. That means: Better guest templates Better escalation rules Better AI prompts Better training examples Better quality control Better reporting Better internal notes Better workflows between guests, vendors, cleaners, and the operations team We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the function, not just complete a shift. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for someone who is: COMMUNICATION Excellent in written English Strong spoken English preferred Clear, calm, warm, and professional Able to write naturally, not robotically Able to communicate with guests who are tired, confused, frustrated, or in a hurry Able to follow templates without sounding like a script TEMPERAMENT Calm under pressure Reliable during the agreed schedule Detail-oriented Patient with guests Comfortable handling multiple conversations at once Able to work independently during overnight coverage Hungry for more responsibility over time JUDGMENT Knows when to solve and when to escalate Does not overpromise Does not ignore details Can follow SOPs carefully Notices patterns in repeated guest issues Thinks in root causes, not just one-off replies Can be trusted with guest-facing communication SYSTEMS AND AI Comfortable learning new software tools Comfortable using ChatGPT or willing to learn quickly Interested in AI, automation, systems, or process improvement Able to review AI-generated messages and d ---------- whether they are accurate and appropriate Excited by the idea of helping train AI-assisted guest communication over time You do not need to be a developer. But you should be the kind of person who says: “I answered the guest correctly, but why did they need to ask this in the first place?” That mindset matters. THIS ROLE IS A STRONG FIT IF YOU Have experience in guest messaging, customer support, hospitality, virtual assistance, or operations Have supported U.S.-based customers or guests before Can write excellent English without sounding robotic Are comfortable working U.S. Pacific Time hours Can handle multiple chats or messages at once Stay calm when guests are upset or confused Like improving templates, SOPs, and processes Are interested in AI tools and automation Want to grow into a larger role over time Are based in the Philippines and comfortable working remotely Bonus points if you have experience with: Airbnb Hospitable Guesty OwnerRez Hostaway Slack ClickUp Notion Google Sheets ChatGPT or other AI tools Short-term rental operations Customer support QA SOP creation Process improvement Guest messaging management Night shift or overnight support THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF Please do not apply if: Your written English is weak You only want a basic VA task list You dislike following processes You get flustered when guests are upset You do not want to learn new tools You are not interested in AI, systems, or process improvement You want a role where you only do what you are told and never think critically You cannot work reliably during the agreed schedule You are uncomfortable being measured on quality, reliability, and improvement We are not looking for someone who just “handles messages.” We are looking for someone who wants to master guest communication and help us build a better operating system around it. THE QUALITY BAR Because written English is the core of this job, here is the standard. You should be able to write messages like these naturally: “Hi Sarah, thanks for reaching out. I’m sorry about the confusion. Let me check this for you right now and I’ll follow up shortly.” “You’re all set. The cleaner confirmed the item was found, and we’ll coordinate the best way to get it back to you.” “I understand how frustrating that must be. I’ve escalated this to our maintenance team and will keep you updated as soon as I hear back.” Clear. Calm. Human. Accurate. That is the bar. WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE BY 30 DAYS You understand our properties, tools, SOPs, and guest communication standards You can handle routine guest messages with limited help Your written replies are consistently clear, warm, and professional You escalate the right issues to the right people You are dependable during your assigned schedule BY 90 DAYS You can independently handle most guest messaging situations Your judgment is reliable enough that the operations team trusts your decisions You have identified recurring guest questions or workflow problems You have suggested improvements to templates, SOPs, or escalation rules You are using AI tools to improve speed and quality BY 180 DAYS You are not just running the workflow, you are improving it You have helped implement concrete improvements to guest communication You are contributing examples, feedback, and ideas that improve AI-assisted operations You are becoming a true owner inside the guest communication function, not just a message responder EXAMPLE OF THE MINDSET WE WANT A normal guest messaging person says: “The guest asked for the WiFi, so I sent the WiFi.” A great person in this role says: “The guest asked for the WiFi, so I sent it. But this is the fifth time guests have asked this property for WiFi this month, so maybe the check-in instructions are unclear. I recommend adding WiFi to the first arrival message.” That is the difference. A normal guest messaging person says: “The guest said the door code did not work, so I escalated it.” A great person in this role says: “The guest said the door code did not work, so I escalated it. But I also checked whether the code was sent correctly, whether the guest was at the correct door, and whether this has happened before at this property.” That is what we are looking for. SCHEDULE AND GROWTH PATH This role starts at 10 to 25 hours per week. Coverage during U.S. Pacific Time hours is required. Overnight guest support is part of this role. We are starting part-time intentionally. The first phase is about learning the business, proving reliability, showing strong judgment, and demonstrating that you can handle guest communication with increasing independence. For the right person, this can become a full-time role after the initial period. As OODA grows, we want to build long-term roles around the people who prove they can own real parts of the operation. That may mean expanded hours, full-time contractor work, a formal employment role, quality assurance ownership, team leadership, or a more specialized AI operations position. This is not a short-term task list. It is an entry point into the operating team of a company being built for scale. WHEN YOU MESSAGE US When you message us, please briefly tell us: Your guest messaging, customer support, hospitality, VA, or operations experience Your availability in U.S. Pacific Time Your desired hourly rate What tools you have used before Whether you have used ChatGPT or other AI tools Why this role interests you beyond basic guest messaging Also include the word PINEAPPLE at the top of your message so we know you read the full post.

title: Mortgage Operations Assistant
description: MINDFUL LENDING Loan Partner — Mortgage Operations Assistant About This Role We are a US-based mortgage brokerage in California helping move-up homebuyers across 12 states gain mastery in homeownership. Our work is detail-heavy, document-heavy, and deadline-driven. We are looking for one full-time Loan Partner to join our team and own the document collection, file organization, and conditions tracking work that keeps our pipeline moving. This is not a generic VA role. You will be working inside live mortgage files — for W2 borrowers, self-employed borrowers, and Non-QM scenarios — and your accuracy directly affects whether families close on time. If you have 2+ years processing experience in the broker channel and you take pride in being the most organized person on the team, we want to hear from you. Hard Requirements (Apply Only If You Meet ALL of These) Experience 2+ years of mortgage loan processing experience in the broker channel (not retail, not banking) Hands-on experience with W2 borrower documentation Hands-on experience with self-employed borrower documentation, including 2 years of personal and business tax returns Tools (Familiarity Preferred) You do not need to be an expert in these tools to apply — training will be provided. However, prior familiarity with any or all of these is strongly preferred and will accelerate your ramp: Google Workspace (Docs, Gmail, Sheets, Drive) BNTouch CRM Lending Pad LOS Homebot Lender Familiarity (Preferred) Nexa Lending, UWM, Kind Lending, REMN, or similar broker-channel wholesale lenders Communication Fluent written and spoken English Stable internet connection capable of full-day Zoom video Quiet, professional home work setup References Two professional references from prior mortgage-related employment within the last 2 years Each reference must include name, phone number, and email References must be from supervisors or loan officers you directly supported, not coworkers EXCEPTION: If you have been continuously employed with a single employer for more than 24 months, ONE reference from that employer is acceptable. Two references from different employers is still preferred where possible. Availability and Commitment (Non-Negotiable) You must be able to start within 7 calendar days of accepting the offer. If your timeline is longer than 7 days, this role is not a fit. This role is exclusive and full-time. You will not work for any other Loan Officer, mortgage broker, real estate professional, or US-based client during your employment with Mindful Lending. No side gigs, no part-time clients, no exceptions. Candidates currently available to start immediately — including those recently laid off or between roles — are strongly encouraged to apply. By applying, you confirm that if hired, Mindful Lending will be your sole employer and your full professional focus. If you do not meet all the requirements above, please do not apply. We will verify everything. Schedule and Work Hours Core Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST, Monday – Friday Manila equivalent: 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM PHT (midnight to 8 AM) This is a night shift in the Philippines. You must be able to commit to this schedule consistently. If you have caregiving obligations, a second job, or sleep patterns that conflict with overnight work, this role is not a fit. During the first 90 days: On Zoom with camera on for the full PST window Continuously monitoring Zoom and available immediately for team support throughout the day Flexibility is a core skill — priorities shift, urgent files come up, and you respond No exceptions on the camera-on policy except for breaks Break Structure (Unpaid): You choose one of two break options each day, declared at the morning meeting so the team knows when you are off: Option A: One full hour, taken between 12:00 and 1:00 PM PST Option B: Two 30-minute breaks — one between 11:30 AM and 12:30 PM PST, one between 2:30 and 3:30 PM PST Camera off, no Zoom required during breaks. Breaks are unpaid. You are responsible for accurately logging which option you took each day on your activity log. After 90 days (performance-based): Optional 8:00 AM PST start (1 hour earlier) if you want to get ahead on the day This early start is a privilege earned through proactive performance, not a default Daily Schedule: The schedule below is an example of how a typical day flows. Actual daily tasks and timing will vary based on pipeline activity, urgent files, and team priorities. You will be given clear, specific instructions on what to execute each day — clarity is a core value of how we operate, and you will never be left guessing what is expected. PST Manila Activity 9:00 – 9:15 AM 12:00 – 12:15 AM Standup with Operations Manager. Review priority files, urgent conditions, new leads. 9:15 – 10:30 AM 12:15 – 1:30 AM Process overnight email inbox. Pull uploaded docs into G Drive. Verify document integrity. Re-request anything wrong or missing. 10:30 AM – 12:00 PM 1:30 – 3:00 AM Walk every active file. Identify missing docs. Send first-round follow-ups (email + text). Request VOEs from employers. 12:00 – 1:00 PM* 3:00 – 4:00 AM* BREAK (unpaid, 1 hour OR two 30-min blocks — declared at standup) 1:00 – 2:30 PM 4:00 – 5:30 AM Upload received docs to correct G Drive folders (Asset, Credit, ID, Income, Property, Property Profile). Update conditions tracker. 2:30 – 3:30 PM 5:30 – 6:30 AM Pre-approval prep and conditions work. Run completeness checks. Notify Operations Manager when files are ready for analysis. 3:30 – 4:30 PM 6:30 – 7:30 AM Second-round follow-ups. Phone calls to clients on stalled docs. Text and email follow-ups. 4:30 – 5:00 PM 7:30 – 8:00 AM End-of-day wrap. Update CRM pipeline notes. Send EOD summary to Operations Manager and Founder. What You Will Own 1. Document Collection and Follow-Up This is your daily core work. Every active file gets reviewed every morning. Missing documents get followed up on the same day, every day, until they are received. For W2 Clients, you will collect: 2 most recent months of bank statements Credit report ID, work permit, or green card 30 most recent days of paystubs W2s for the past 2 years Year-end (December) paystubs for the past 2 years Verification of Employment (VOE) completed by employer Tax returns (if borrower owns multiple properties) For every property owned: mortgage statements, homeowner's insurance, property tax bill, HOA statements, solar lease or PPA agreements Title report for every property owned For Self-Employed Clients, you will collect: 2 most recent months of business and personal bank statements Credit report ID, work permit, or green card 2 most recent years of tax returns (personal and business) For every property owned: mortgage statements, homeowner's insurance, property tax bill, HOA statements, solar lease or PPA agreements Title report for every property owned If using Non-QM: 12 months of rent or mortgage history for all owned properties 2. File Organization in Google Drive Every active file has a G Drive folder set up with the following structure: Asset Credit ID Income Property (mortgage statements, HOA docs, insurance, property tax bills, solar agreements — sub-folders for each property if borrower owns multiple) Property Profile (Ticor reports go here) 3. Pre-Approval File Prep Before any file is handed off for pre-approval analysis, you confirm: Income docs collected and verified Asset docs collected and verified ID and SSN collected Basic completeness check passed All pre-approval related docs collected Then you notify the Operations Manager that the file is ready for analysis. 4. Conditions Tracking You maintain the conditions tracker (Google Sheet or CRM) and update it daily. Every condition has one of three statuses: Pending, Requested, or Received. The Operations Manager reviews conditions and tells you what to collect. You request, track, and follow up. Reporting Structure and Communication Reports to: Operations Manager (Pre-Underwriter) Communication tools: Zoom (live presence and meetings), Email (client and lender comms), WhatsApp (internal team and urgent client touch) Internal response time during work hours: Within 2 minutes — Zoom is monitored continuously and you are available immediately for support Flexibility: Priorities shift throughout the day. Adapting quickly to new urgent files and changing requests is a core skill of this role, not an exception. How Performance Is Measured We measure work, not effort. You will know exactly where you stand at the end of every day, every week, and at day 90. Daily Tracker (you fill out at end of day): Metric Daily Target Active files reviewed 100% of active pipeline Missing-doc follow-ups sent 1 touch per outstanding item per day Docs received and filed correctly 100% same-day filing Conditions tracker updated 100?curacy by EOD CRM pipeline notes added 100% of active files EOD summary sent By 5:00 PM PST daily Weekly Performance Metrics (reviewed Mondays): Metric Weekly Target Doc collection cycle time ? 7 calendar days per file Pre-approval handoff first-try completeness ? 90% Conditions clearing speed ? 3 business days average Stalled file contact attempts 2+ per week per file Doc integrity (right doc, legible, current) ? 95?cepted on first review Internal communication response time ? 2 minutes during work hours 90-Day Evaluation (gate to wage increase and continued employment): At day 90, you must hit all six of these to continue and receive the wage increase: Average doc collection cycle time ? 7 days across all files handled Pre-approval handoff rework rate ? 10% Zero missed conditions deadlines that caused a closing delay 100% on-camera attendance during scheduled hours (lunch excluded) Two unsolicited positive client mentions OR one positive realtor-partner mention Compensation and Career Growth This is a long-term position with a defined wage progression. We are looking for someone we can grow with for years, not months. Your earnings increase as your skills, ownership, and contribution to the team expand. Note: The metrics referenced below are examples of what we have seen drive success in this role historically. Actual performance expectations may differ. Specific, written metrics of success will be confirmed and provided to you prior to your start date, so you know exactly what you are working toward from day one. Tier 1 — Starting Rate: $7.50 USD per hour Days 1 through 90. The ramp and trial period. You are learning our systems, our team, and our standards while contributing on every active file. Tier 2 — Established Rate: $8.00 USD per hour Granted upon successful completion of the 90-day evaluation (criteria listed above in the Performance section). This is the "you have proven you can do the job consistently" raise. From day 91 forward. Tier 3 — Senior Loan Partner Rate: $9.00 USD per hour Earned through demonstrating skills beyond core processing — leadership, ownership, and process improvement. To reach Tier 3, you must hit ALL of the following for two consecutive months: Full pipeline ownership: Manages 100% of conditions, submissions, and pipeline updates for the active 3–5 loan pipeline without prompting Zero missing docs at handoff: When a file is passed off for pre-approval, it greenlights from the Operations Manager on the first review — no missing docs, no rework ? 90% of files passed to Operations Manager rated "Green" on the internal file status tracker (Green = complete on first pass; Yellow = minor items missing; Red = sent back for rework) Has received at least one positive feedback via text, email , or verbal communication from a realtor partner, transaction coordinator, or title tea ---------- mber — conveyed to the Loan Officer Has identified and implemented at least one documented process improvement that saved time or reduced errors Operates with minimal direction — proactively flags issues, surfaces solutions, and runs the daily workflow without prompting Typical time to reach Tier 3: 6 to 12 months for a strong hire. This is not automatic — it is earned by demonstrating you have grown into more than the starting role. Other Terms Hours: Full-time, 35 paid hours per week (9am–5pm PST with 1 hour unpaid break) Pay cycle: Every two weeks Payroll process: You submit a bi-weekly invoice with a daily activity log. Each day's entry must include start time, end time, break option taken (1 hour OR two 30-min blocks), total paid hours, and a brief activity summary. Template provided. Approximate monthly earnings (full-time): $1,137 USD at Tier 1, $1,213 at Tier 2, $1,365 at Tier 3 How to Apply Send your application to: ---------- Subject line: Loan Partner Application — [Your Full Name] In your message, include: Your full name and current city in the Philippines Confirmation that you can work 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST (midnight to 8 AM Manila) Monday through Friday Your current employment status (employed, between roles, recently laid off, etc.) and the earliest date you could start. Note: start date must be within 7 calendar days of offer. Explicit confirmation that you are not currently working for, and will not work for, any other Loan Officer, mortgage broker, real estate professional, or US-based client while employed with Mindful Lending A summary of your mortgage processing experience: which broker channel(s), which lenders, how many years, what types of files (W2, self-employed, Non-QM) Which of the required tools you have used (Google Workspace, BNTouch, Lending Pad, Homebot) Your two professional references (name, phone, email , and your relationship to each) A 1–2 minute Loom or video introduction in English explaining why you are a fit for this role Applications missing any of the above will not be reviewed. We are looking for someone who reads instructions carefully and follows them — that is the job. A Final Note Mindful Lending is built on four values: compassion, selflessness, courage, and integrity. We treat our team the way we treat our clients — with respect, clarity, and a real commitment to your growth. If you are looking for a long-term home where your work matters and your accuracy is the difference between a family closing on time or not, apply. We will respond to qualified applicants within 5 business days.

title: Inbound Appointment Setter - Hair Salon (Remote, Full-Time, Pacific Time)
job_title: Inbound Appointment Setter - Hair Salon (Remote, Full-Time, Pacific Time)
description: ABOUT US We are a family-owned hair salon based in Southern California that has been operating for over 20 years. Our specialty is color and highlight services, and our clients are primarily women aged 35 to 65 who come back to us for years. Over the past year, we've built out a Meta ads funnel using GoHighLevel as our CRM and phone system, and we're now generating a steady flow of inbound leads from Facebook and Instagram. I'm hiring one full-time appointment setter to handle all of those leads and book them into the salon. This is a long-term role. I'm looking for someone who wants to stay with us for at least a year and grow into the position. WHAT YOU'LL DO You will be the only person responsible for converting our inbound leads into booked appointments. - Work inbound leads from our Meta ads through call, SMS, and DM (Facebook and Instagram) inside GoHighLevel - Run our booking script as written: discovery questions, offer presentation, and the card-on-file close - Handle objections using the framework I will train you on (reframe value, build trust, induce gentle urgency without being pushy) - Send Stripe payment links to capture the card on file, then book the appointment in our calendar - Charge the card on file in Stripe for any late cancels or no-shows (a few minutes per day) - Log every interaction cleanly in the CRM so I can review conversion data and refine the script over time The most important ---------- nt on every call is getting the card on file. Once we have it, our show rate jumps from around 55% to 90%, so that is the part of the script that matters most. KPI TARGETS This is a high-volume, metrics-driven role. You will know exactly how you are performing every day. - Calls per day: 150 to 250 - Leads worked per day: 17 to 25 - Lead-to-booking rate: 25% or higher - Show rate: 90% or higher (after card on file) - Bookings per day: 4 to 9 - Showed appointments per month: 100 to 160 WHAT I NEED YOU TO KNOW BEFORE APPLYING Script adherence is a dealbreaker. We need you to follow the script word for word on the key parts of every call. We use conversion data to test what's working and what isn't, and if everyone is freestyling their own version, the data is useless. If you have ideas to improve the script, we genuinely want to hear them, but you raise them with as feedback, not by changing things on calls. The schedule is fixed. Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time. For someone in the Philippines, that is 11:45 PM to 8:45 AM PHT (an overnight shift). No exceptions, no shift swaps, no occasional late starts. I need someone who has actually worked overnight shifts before and knows they can sustain it for at least 12 months. Tech reliability is non-negotiable. The role does not work if your internet drops two or three times a week. I will ask about your backup plan (mobile hotspot or second ISP), and we will test your connection and audio live from your actual work setup before any offer. REQUIREMENTS - 6 to 12 months of phone-based sales, appointment setting, or BPO experience (4+ hours per day on the phone) - Clear, neutral English with strong listening skills (you'll be talking to US-based women aged 35 to 65 all day) - Comfortable with high call volume (150 to 250 dials per day) and a long-term commitment to that pace - Strong script discipline and comfort operating inside a defined process - Reliable home office setup: 8GB RAM minimum (16GB preferred), wired headset with boom mic, computer mouse, internet at 25 to 50 Mbps down and 10 to 20 Mbps up, ping under 50ms, and a real backup internet plan you have actually used - Available Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM US Pacific Time (overnight in the Philippines) NICE TO HAVE - Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (CRM and phone) - Experience with Stripe payment links - Background in B2C inbound sales (beauty, wellness, fitness, medspa, or salon) - Personal interest in beauty, hair, or self-care COMPENSATION - Base: $900 USD per month - Performance bonuses: $3 per new client show, $2 per existing client show, $1 per rebooking show - Monthly threshold bonuses (cumulative): +$75 at 90 shows, +$150 at 120 shows, +$350 at 150 shows - On-target earnings: approximately $1,300 to $1,815 per month - PTO: 14 days per year after a 90-day probation period - Payment: Paid through ---------- on a regular schedule - Equipment: I will buy you a headset if you need one. Computer and internet are yours. To be straightforward about the structure: roughly 30 to 50% of your monthly income will come from performance bonuses. If you want a high guaranteed base with low expectations, this isn't the right fit. If you want a clear path to earn more by actually performing, the math works well here. HOW TO APPLY Submit a link to your updated resume  and Please send me a a cover letter explaining: 1. Your most relevant phone-based sales or appointment setting experience (how long, what industry, what volume) 2. Your history with overnight shifts and how long you sustained that schedule 3. Your home internet speeds (down/up) and your backup plan 4. Whether you can commit to the Monday through Friday, 7:45 AM to 4:45 PM PST schedule for at least 12 months

title: Virtual Front Desk Assistant – Regenerative Medicine Clinic + General VA Support (Long-Term)
job_title: Virtual Front Desk Assistant – Regenerative Medicine Clinic + General VA Support (Long-Term)
description: ABOUT US We are Integrative Medical, a regenerative medicine clinic in the Phoenix, AZ, Metro area. We have been serving our community since 2012, and we pride ourselves on warm patient experience, efficient care, and personalized attention. Our small team values professionalism, kindness, accountability, and getting things done right the first time. WE ARE HIRING A VIRTUAL FRONT DESK ASSISTANT A friendly, sharp, and proactive VA to be the front-desk voice of our clinic — and to help with other projects during idle time. This is a long-term role for someone who wants stability, variety, and a workplace that values upbeat, solution-oriented people. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be the first point of contact for patients calling our clinic. Between calls, you'll handle scheduling, administrative work, outreach to new patients and clients, and a rotating mix of VA tasks for other projects we run. No two days look exactly the same. We'll provide structured onboarding, SOPs, and training on our systems — you don't need to know our specific tools on day one, but you do need to be a fast learner. WHAT YOU'LL DO (CLINIC) - Answer incoming patient calls professionally and warmly - Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments - Handle administrative tasks using office software (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, etc.) - New patient onboarding and outreach (calls, email s, follow-ups) - New client outreach and lead follow-up - Other front-desk and admin duties as needed WHAT YOU'LL DO (OTHER PROJECTS, DURING IDLE TIME) - General virtual assistant tasks across our other business projects - Research, data entry, email management, document prep, light project coordination - Whatever is needed to keep things moving — we'll always brief you clearly This varied mix is part of the role itself. As you grow into the position and demonstrate strong performance, responsibilities and pay can expand over time. TEAM & REPORTING You'll be our first and only VA hire, reporting directly to the doctor. Your day-to-day interactions will primarily be with patients and other callers — you'll be the front-line voice of the clinic. MUST-HAVES - Excellent spoken English — clear, neutral, easy to understand on the phone - Excellent written English — professional, error-free email s and messages - Upbeat, cheerful, positive personality (this matters — patients can hear it) - Proactive and solution-oriented — you spot problems and bring fixes, not just questions - Comfortable with office software (Google Workspace and/or MS Office, calendar tools, spreadsheets, basic docs) - Reliable internet, quiet workspace, working headset, and a backup power/internet plan - Long-term commitment — we are not looking for short-term help - Comfortable handling confidential patient information. As a medical clinic, we operate under HIPAA. You'll be required to sign a confidentiality agreement and Business Associate Agreement (BAA) before you start, and to follow our patient privacy protocols on every call and every record. - Able to work US business hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Phoenix/Arizona time (roughly 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Manila time). Please only apply if you're confident you can work and thrive on this schedule long-term. NICE-TO-HAVES - Prior experience in a medical, dental, or healthcare front-desk role - Experience with US clients - Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems, scheduling platforms, or VoIP phone systems - Experience with CRMs or outreach tools EQUIPMENT & TOOLS You provide: - A capable computer that can smoothly handle VoIP calls while running our CRM, EHR, and office software at the same time (minimum 8GB RAM, ideally 16GB; modern processor; Windows or Mac) - An excellent noise-cancelling USB headset — clear audio quality is essential since you'll be speaking with patients - High-speed, reliable internet (at least 25 Mbps) with a backup connection (second ISP or mobile hotspot) - UPS or backup power for brownouts - A quiet, private, distraction-free workspace — this means a home office or dedicated room. Working from a call center, BPO floor, or shared workspace is not acceptable — patients must hear only you on the line. We provide: All clinic software and logins (EHR, scheduling, CRM), a HIPAA-compliant VoIP phone system for patient calls, training materials, and SOPs. SCHEDULE & COMPENSATION - Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Phoenix/Arizona time (8.5 hours work + 30-minute unpaid lunch break) - Type: Full-time (42.5 hours/week paid) - Pay: $500–$650/month USD, based on experience - 90-day probation period. During this time, we'll evaluate fit on both sides. After successfully completing probation, you'll receive a formal performance review, paid time off and sick leave begin accruing, and the 13th month bonus becomes effective. - Performance-based raises after probation, with annual reviews thereafter PAID TIME OFF (after 90-day probation) - 10 days paid vacation per year, accruing monthly - 5 days paid sick leave per year - Paid time off when the clinic is closed for US holidays (you work your regular schedule on days the clinic is open) PAYMENT - Paid in USD, semi-monthly on the 1st and 16th of each month - Sent via Remitly, received in your GCash wallet - 13th month bonus paid in mid-December START DATE We're aiming to fill this role within 4–6 weeks of posting. We're willing to wait for the right long-term fit, including reasonable notice periods if you're currently employed. HOW TO APPLY Please send the following: 1. A short message telling me why this role is a fit for you 2. Your resume / CV 3. A short video (3–5 minutes) where you: - Introduce yourself - Walk me through your work experience - Share your top skills and strengths - Share one honest weakness you're working on To show you actually read this post, please open your application with two things: 1. Your current time zone, and confirmation you can work the hours listed above 2. One specific thing from this post that made you want to apply for this role Applications that skip these will not be reviewed. HIRING PROCESS 1. Application review (we'll respond to shortlisted candidates within 7 days of applying) 2. 15-minute video screening call 3. Paid trial task (small, paid at the hourly equivalent of the role) 4. Final interview and offer Looking forward to meeting you!
